qe: Pataliputra of ancient Magadha is called the 'eternal city' of India because three great imperial powers ruled from it at different times. Which were they?
qh: पाटलिपुत्र को भारत का 'शाश्वत नगर' कहा जाता है क्योंकि तीन बड़ी साम्राज्य-शक्तियों ने अलग-अलग काल में यहीं से शासन किया। वे कौन थीं?
e: Pataliputra yaani aaj ka Patna prachin Bharat ke sabse mahatvapurn rajnitik kendra raha. Magadha ka ek chhota rajya 6th century BC me Bimbisara ke samay se badhta gaya tatha Mahapadma Nanda ne uttar Bharat ko ek kiya; uske baad Maurya samrajya ne yahan se poore desh par raj kiya. Mauryon ke patan ke lagbhag paanch sau saal baad Gupta shasakon ne Pataliputra ko hi apni rajdhani banakar uttar Bharat ki ekta dobara sthapit ki, tatha uske paanch sau saal baad Pala shasakon ne bhi isi nagar se raj karne ki parampara nibhai - isliye ise 'shaashvat nagar' (eternal city) kaha jaata hai. Yah parampara aaj tak chalti hai kyunki Bihar ki aaj ki rajdhani bhi Patna hi hai tatha Ganga ke kinare basa yah shahar maurya-kaaleen Kumrahar tatha Bulandibagh jaise puratatv-sthalon se ghira hua hai. Exam point: Pataliputra Maurya, Gupta tatha Pala - teeno ki rajdhani-kendra; aaj ka Patna kisi bhi ek samrajya ka nahi balki teen badi shaktiyon ka rajnetik kendra raha; Ganga ke kinare basa yah nagar aaj Bihar ki rajdhani hai.

qe: In the 6th century BC, which king ruled Magadha when it was still one of the many small states of the region?
qh: छठी शताब्दी ईसा-पूर्व में मगध पर किस शासक का राज था, जब वह क्षेत्र के अनेक छोटे राज्यों में से एक था?
e: 6th century BC me Magadha dakshin Bihar ka ek chhota rajya tha jiske shasak Bimbisara the tatha aas-paas Anga, Vajji, Malla jaise kai anya chhote rajya bhi maujood the. Bimbisara ke uttaradhikariyon ne dhire-dhire seemayein badhai tatha agle sau-bhar saal me Magadha angrajyon me sarvashreshth ban gaya; isi parampara ko Mahapadma Nanda ne aage badhaya, jinhone uttar Bharat ke bade hisse ko ek shasak ke adheen kar diya. Iske baad Chandragupta Maurya ne sikandar ke baad ki rajnitik khaali jagah bhar kar poora uttar tatha madhya Bharat jodkar bharat ka pehla sarva-bharatiya samrajya khada kiya; Samudragupta Gupta kaal me isi vistarit samrajya ki neev par raj kiya. Isi liye 'chhote rajya se samrajya tak' ki yatra Magadha ke Haryanka kaal ke Bimbisara se maani jaati hai, isliye sahi uttar Bimbisara hai. Exam point: 6th century BC me Magadha ek chhota rajya tha jiska raja Bimbisara tha; uske baad Mahapadma Nanda ne uttar Bharat ka bada hissa joda tatha Mauryon ne pehla sarva-bharatiya samrajya khada kiya.

qe: The long-lost text of Kautilya's Arthashastra, a work associated with the Maurya court, was recovered from where?
qh: मौर्य दरबार से जुड़ा कौटिल्य का अर्थशास्त्र, जो कालांतर में खो गया था, कहाँ से पुनः प्राप्त हुआ?
oe: From a southern corner of India
e: Kautilya, jinko Chanakya bhi kaha jaata hai, Chandragupta Maurya ke pradhanmantri the tatha unke netritva me Nanda rajavansh hata kar Maurya vansh sthapit hua; unki rachna 'Arthashastra' rajniti, prashasan, kar-vyavastha, kanoon tatha arthavyavastha ka vishal granth hai. Is granth ki rachna Bihar ke rajnitik mahaul me hui maani jaati hai - Kautilya ke baare me parampara kehti hai ki unhone apna jeevan Magadha ke darbaron me bitaya; isliye yah karya Bihar se juda maana jaata hai. Yeh granth itna prabhavshali tha ki aage ke sabhi raja tatha rajnitigya ise aadarsh guide maante the. Dilchasp baat yah hai ki yah granth Bharat me kai sadiyon tak lapata raha aur iski ek purani pandulipi bharat ke sabse dakshin korner (Mysore kshetra) ki library se mili, jisse yah dobara duniya ke saamne aaya. Isliye sahi uttar 'Bharat ke dakshini kone se' hai. Exam point: Arthashastra ki rachna Kautilya/Chanakya ne Magadha ke rajnitik mahaul me ki; purani pandulipi Bharat ke dakshini kone (Mysore) se mili; Granth prashasan, kar tatha kanoon ka aadhaar-granth maana jaata hai.

qe: Which ideal did ancient Magadha and Pataliputra give to the rest of India?
qh: प्राचीन मगध तथा पाटलिपुत्र ने शेष भारत को कौन-सा आदर्श दिया?
oe: The ideal of political unity of India
The ideal of a single world religion
The ideal of a money-less economy
oh: भारत की राजनीतिक एकता का आदर्श
e: Prachin kaal me Bihar ne 'bharat ki rajnitik ekta' ke aadarsh ko janm diya tatha use vyavhar me utara. Magadha ke chhote rajya se shuru hokar Mahapadma Nanda, Maurya, Gupta tatha Pala shasakon ke prayas se ek vishal kshetra ek hi shasan-vyavastha, ek hi bhasha tatha ek hi shasan-lekh ke adheen aaya; Maurya samrajya ke samay Pataliputra se likhit aadesh Himalaya se Hindu Kush, Kathiawar, Arabian Sagar, Mysore ke pathar tatha Bangal ki khadi-Brahmaputra tak pahunchte the. Isi ekta ne bhasha, lipi, dharm tatha kala ke aadan-pradan ko aasan banaya tatha Mauryon ke patan ke baad bhi bharat ki sanskritik ekta bani rahi. Rajnitik ekta ke saath-saath sahishnuta tatha sanskritik aadan-pradan bhi isi aadarsh ka hissa raha; isliye sahi uttar 'bharat ki rajnitik ekta ka aadarsh' hai. Exam point: Magadha-Pataliputra ka sarvadhik mahatvapurn yogdaan = bharat ki rajnitik ekta ka aadarsh tatha uske liye pehli baar vistarit prashasan-vyavastha ka nirman; Maurya samrajya poore uttar-madhya bharat ko ek shasan me laaya.

qe: Which ancient kingdom, associated with Raja Janaka and the philosopher Yajnavalkya, formed the northern part of today's Bihar region?
qh: राजा जनक तथा दार्शनिक याज्ञवल्क्य से जुड़ा प्राचीन राज्य, जो आज के बिहार क्षेत्र का उत्तरी हिस्सा था, कौन-सा है?
e: Videha rajya aaj ke uttar Bihar ke Mithila kshetra me tha; uski pehchan Raja Janaka tatha unke darbar ke vidwan Yajnavalkya se hai; Brihadaranyaka Upanishad me Janaka tatha Yajnavalkya ke beech hue gambhir darshanik samvad milte hain. Bihar Janaka tatha Yagnavalkya ki bhoomi maana jaata hai tatha yahi Gautama, Mahavira, Buddha, Chandragupta, Chanakya tatha Ashoka ki bhi bhoomi rahi. Anga rajya aaj ke Bhagalpur-Munger kshetra me tha tatha uski rajdhani Champa thi; Kashi (Varanasi) tatha Kosala (Ayodhya) aaj ke Uttar Pradesh me the, isliye woh vikalp sahi nahi hain. Isi liye Janaka-Yajnavalkya se jude rajy ka sahi naam Videha (Mithila) hai. Exam point: Videha = Mithila kshetra, Raja Janaka tatha Yajnavalkya se juda prachin rajya; Anga ki rajdhani Champa (Bhagalpur-Munger kshetra); Kosala tatha Kashi aaj UP me hain.

qe: The lion capital and the famous bull capital of Ashokan pillars were both discovered at which place in West Champaran, Bihar?
qh: अशोक-स्तंभ के सिंह-शीर्ष तथा प्रसिद्ध वृषभ (बैल) शीर्ष दोनों बिहार के पश्चिम चंपारण में कहाँ मिले थे?
e: Rampurva Pashchim Champaran me sthit ek sthal hai jahan Ashoka ke do stambh-shirsh milte hain - ek sinha-shirsh (lion capital) tatha ek vrishabh-shirsh (bull capital); yah dono aaj Patna Museum tatha National Museum me surakshit hain. Ashoka ne apne dhamma ka prachar karne ke liye poore samrajya me patthar ke stambh lagwaye tatha un par prakrut bhasha me sandesh khudwaye; Bihar me aise stambh Rampurva, Lauriya Nandangarh, Lauriya Araraj tatha Kolhua (Vaishali) me mile hain. Rampurva ka vrishabh-shirsh isliye khaas hai kyunki aise pashu-shirsh Maurya kaal ki dhatu-kala tatha patthar par polish ke sabse sudar udaharan maane jaate hain. Lauriya Nandangarh ka stambh abhi bhi apni jagah khada hai tatha wahan ek bada tila (Nandangarh) bhi hai; Kolhua me sinha-stambh hai. Isliye dono capitals ke liye sahi uttar Rampurva hai. Exam point: Rampurva (Pashchim Champaran) = Ashoka ke sinha-shirsh tatha vrishabh-shirsh dono stambh-shirsh mile; Bihar me Ashokan stambh Rampurva, Lauriya Nandangarh, Lauriya Araraj tatha Kolhua (Vaishali) me hain.

qe: The polished Yakshi figure found at Didarganj near Patna, a masterpiece of Mauryan art, is displayed in which museum?
qh: पटना के निकट दीदारगंज से मिली पॉलिशयुक्त यक्षी मूर्ति, जो मौर्य कला की उत्कृष्ट कृति है, किस संग्रहालय में प्रदर्शित है?
e: Didarganj (Patna) me Ganga ke kinare se ek sundar pathar ki yakshi murti mili thi; yah Maurya kaal ki kala ka sabse prasiddh namuna maani jaati hai kyunki iske patthar par chikni polish hai tatha aakriti bahut jeevant hai - ise 'Didarganj Yakshi' kaha jaata hai tatha yah aaj Patna Museum me rakhi hai. Maurya kaal ki kala ki khaas pehchan chunni (polish) wala patthar tatha chamakdar surface hai; isi tarah Kumrahar (Patna) ke prachin 'sabhaghar' ke khambhe tatha Barabar ki pahadiyon ki gufaon me bhi yahi polish dikhti hai. Aisi murtiyan batati hain ki us samay nagar-sabhyata me shilp tatha kaarigari kitni unnati prapt thi tatha vastra tatha aabhushan ki bareeki kaisi thi. National Museum, Indian Museum tatha Sarnath Museum me bhi Maurya-Gupta kaal ki manya vastuein hain, lekin Didaarganj Yakshi Patna Museum ki shaan hai. Exam point: Didaarganj Yakshi = Maurya kaal ki polish-wali patthar murti, Patna Museum me; Maurya kala ki pehchan chikni chunni/patthar-polish hai, jaisi Kumrahar ke sabhaghar ke khambhon me bhi dikhti hai.

qe: Remains of a pillared assembly hall of the Mauryan period were excavated at which locality of Patna?
qh: मौर्यकालीन स्तंभ-युक्त सभागार के अवशेष पटना के किस स्थल पर मिले हैं?
e: Patna ke Kumrahar kshetra me khudai me Maurya kaal ke ek bade sabha-grih (pillared hall) ke khambhon ke adhaar mile; unhe dekh kar andaza hota hai ki us samay Pataliputra me lakdi ke khambhon par khadi vishal imartein banti thi. Isi ke paas Bulandibagh me bhi Mauryan kaal ke avashesh mile; wahan se pathar par bani Maurya-kaaleen vastuein tatha terracotta ki chhoti murtiyan mili hain, jo Patna Museum me rakhi hain. In avasheshon ka mahatva isliye bhi hai ki yah prachin sahitya me varnit Pataliputra ke vaibhav ki pushti karte hain, jahan darbar, khazana tatha sainik chhavniyan thi tatha Ganga kinare bade bandargah the. Didarganj se yakshi murti mili, Maner se Sufi dargah (Shah Daulat) tatha Punpun se nadi ka naam juda hai - isliye sabha-grih ke avashesh ke liye sahi uttar Kumrahar hai. Exam point: Kumrahar (Patna) tatha uske paas Bulandibagh = Maurya kaal ke sabha-grih tatha nagar-basav ke avashesh; yahi kshetra prachin Pataliputra ka mukhya hissa maana jaata hai.

qe: The eastern boundary of the Maurya empire extended up to which of the following?
qh: मौर्य साम्राज्य की पूर्वी सीमा निम्नलिखित में से कहाँ तक फैली हुई थी?
oe: The Arabian Sea and the Indus
The Bay of Bengal and the Brahmaputra
e: Maurya samrajya itna vishal tha ki Pataliputra se jaari aadesh (likhit writ) rajy ke ek kone se doosre kone tak pahunchte the; iski seemayein uttar me Himalaya, uttar-pashchim me Hindu Kush, pashchim me Kathiawar tatha Arabian Sagar, dakshin me Mysore ka pathar tatha purab me Bangal ki khadi tatha Brahmaputra nadi tak phaili hui thi. Itne bade kshetra me ek hi bhasha tatha ek hi lipi ke aadesh chalte the, jisse rashtriya ekta ko bal mila; yahi vajah hai ki Maurya samrajya ko bharat ka pehla sarva-bharatiya samrajya kaha jaata hai. Iske aage Gupta tatha Pala shasakon ne bhi ekta sthapit karne ke prayas kiye, isliye Pataliputra ki rajnitik parampara bahut lambi rahi. Indus tatha Arabian Sagar pashchim me tatha Godavari-Krishna dakshin me hain, isliye purabi seema ke liye sahi uttar Bangal ki khadi tatha Brahmaputra hai. Exam point: Maurya samrajya ki purabi seema = Bangal ki khadi tatha Brahmaputra; uttar me Himalaya tatha uttar-pashchim me Hindu Kush tak vistaar; ek hi bhasha-lipi ke shasan-aadesh poore samrajya me chalte the.

qe: Who founded the Haryanka dynasty of Magadha with its capital at Rajagriha (Girivraj), and was a contemporary of both Gautama Buddha and Mahavira?
qh: मगध के हर्यंक वंश का संस्थापक कौन था, जिसकी राजधानी राजगृह (गिरिव्रज) थी तथा जो गौतम बुद्ध तथा महावीर दोनों का समकालीन था?
e: Bimbisara ko unke doosre naam Seniya ya Sreniya se bhi jaana jaata hai; unhone Magadha me Haryanka vansh ki sthapna ki aur Rajagriha (Girivraj) ko rajdhani banaya. Woh Gautam Buddha tatha Mahavira dono ke samkalin the, isliye unka naam bharat ke dharmik itihas me bahut aata hai. Bimbisara ne Anga rajya ko jita aur apne putra Ajatashatru ko wahan ka rajyapal banaya; unhone Rajagriha ke aas-paas pahaadiyon aur nadiyon ka upyog karke Magadha ki sainya-shakti badhai. Magadha ka itihas isi vansh se shuru hota hai, isliye Bimbisara ko Magadha samrajya ka asli neev-daale kehte hain. Ajatashatru unke hi putra the, Udayin unke potra aur Pataliputra ko rajdhani banane wale the, tatha Mahapadma Nanda bahut baad me Nanda vansh ke shasak hue. Exam point: Haryanka vansh ka sansthapak = Bimbisara (Seniya/Sreniya), rajdhani Rajagriha (Girivraj), samkalin - Buddha aur Mahavira.

qe: Which two war machines, 'Mahashilakantaka' and 'Rathamusala', were used by Ajatashatru against the Vajji confederacy?
qh: अजातशत्रु ने वज्जि संघ के विरुद्ध किन दो युद्ध-यंत्रों का प्रयोग किया, जिनके नाम 'महाशिलाकांतक' तथा 'रथमुसल' थे?
oe: A huge stone-hurling catapult and a chariot fitted with swinging maces
A wooden bridge and a water-clock
An iron plough and a horse-drawn drill
A battering ram and a flame thrower
oh: विशाल पत्थर फेंकने वाली गुलेल तथा झूलते मुसलों से युक्त रथ
लोहे का हल तथा घोड़ों से खिंचने वाला बीज-यंत्र
दीवार तोड़ने वाला यंत्र तथा ज्वाला फेंकने वाला यंत्र
e: Ajatashatru ne apne pita Bimbisara ko hatakar Magadha ki satta sanbhaali. Magadha ke uttar me Vajji sangh (jiski rajdhani Vaishali thi) ek ganatantrik (republic-type) sangh tha jisme kai khand milkar shasan karte the; usse jeetna mushkil tha kyunki faisle sabhi sadasya milkar lete the. Is sangh ko harane ke liye Ajatashatru ne do khaas hathiyaar banwaye - 'Mahashilakantaka', ek vishal yantra jo bade patthar phenkta tha, aur 'Rathamusala', aisa rath jisme musal (mace) lage hote the jo chalte samay charon taraf ghoom kar nuksaan karte the. Isi ke saath unhone Vaishali ke paas ek sthal par kile jaisa morcha bana kar lambi gheraabandi ki; us sthal ko 'Jarasanand ka garh' (aaj Rajgir-Bihar Sharif ke beech) bataya jaata hai. Aakhir me Vajji sangh bid gaya tatha Magadha ka vistar uttar ki taraf ho gaya. Wooden bridge, water clock, plough, battering ram wale baki vikalp yuddh-yantron ke bhinn udaharan hain, isliye woh sahi nahi. Exam point: Mahashilakantaka (pathar phenkne wala yantra) aur Rathamusala (musal-wala rath) ka prayog Ajatashatru ne Vajji sangh ke khilaf kiya; Ajatashatru ka doosra naam Kunika tha tatha unhone pratham Buddhist sangiti ko sanrakshan diya.

qe: Which Magadha ruler shifted the capital from Rajagriha to Pataliputra, at the confluence of the Ganga and the Son?
qh: किस मगध शासक ने राजधानी को राजगृह से गंगा तथा सोन के संगम पर स्थित पाटलिपुत्र में स्थानांतरित किया?
e: Udayin (jinka doosra naam Udayabhadra tha) ne Magadha ki rajdhani Rajagriha se hata kar Pataliputra (aaj ka Patna) banai. Unhone yah sthan isliye chuna kyunki yahan Ganga tatha Son nadiyan milti hain; nadiyon ka sangam hone se jald-vyapar (water trade), suraksha aur kheti tino ka laabh ek saath milta tha. Isi karan unhe 'Pataliputra ke sansthapak' tatha 'Magadha ke nadiya prabhutva ke janak' kaha jaata hai. Baad me Maurya tatha Gupta kaal me Pataliputra poore bharat ka sabse bada rajnitik tatha buddhi-jeevi kendra ban gaya; Megasthenes, jo yunanee dutak the, ne bhi is shahar ka varnan kiya. Ashoka Maurya vansh ke samrat the jabki Pataliputra Udayin se pehle rajdhani nahi thi; isliye woh vikalp sahi nahi hai. Bimbisara ki rajdhani sirf Rajagriha thi. Exam point: rajdhani Rajagriha se Pataliputra = Udayin, Ganga-Son sangam ke karan; aage Pataliputra Maurya-Gupta kaal ki rajdhani rahi.

qe: Which Nanda ruler is known by the title 'Sarva-Kshatrantaka' and is regarded as the first historical empire-builder of India?
qh: कौन-सा नन्द शासक 'सर्व-क्षत्रांतक' उपाधि से जाना जाता है तथा भारत के प्रथम ऐतिहासिक साम्राज्य-निर्माता माने जाते हैं?
e: Mahapadma Nanda ko 'Sarva-Kshatrantaka' (sabhi kshatriyon ka ant karne wala) tatha 'Ekarat' (ek hi shasan-karta) jaise khitab mile. Unhone purane kshatriya raajvanshon ko hata kar Magadha me ek bade samrajya ki neev rakhi, isliye unhe bharat ka pehla aitihasik samrajya-nirmata maana jaata hai. Nanda vansh ki sena bahut badi thi aur unhone Ganga ghati ke bade hisse par shasan kiya; isi samrajya ki daulat aur sena ke aadhaar par aage Maurya samrajya ka vistar hua. Panini tatha dharmgranthon me 'Nanda' ka jikra milta hai tatha Jain tatha Buddhist granthon me Nanda vansh ke naam aate hain. Dhana Nanda isi vansh ka aakhri shasak tha, jise Chandragupta Maurya ne hara kar Maurya samrajya sthapit kiya; isliye Dhana Nanda 'first' nahi kehlate. Bimbisara Haryanka vansh ke sansthapak the. Exam point: 'Sarva-Kshatrantaka' tatha 'Ekarat' = Mahapadma Nanda; Nanda vansh ka ant Chandragupta Maurya ne Dhana Nanda ko harakar kiya.

qe: Which Greek ambassador lived in the Mauryan capital Pataliputra and wrote the account 'Indica'?
qh: कौन-सा यूनानी राजदूत मौर्य राजधानी पाटलिपुत्र में रहा तथा 'इंडिका' नामक विवरण लिखा?
e: Chandragupta Maurya ne 303 ee. poo. ke aas-paas Seleucus Nicator (Alexander ke baad Syria tatha Iran ka yunanee shasak) ko hara kar ek sandhi ki; is sandhi ke hisse ke roop me unhe ek yunanee duta apni rajdhani Pataliputra me rakhne ka mauka mila. Wahi duta Megasthenes tha, jisne Pataliputra tatha Maurya prashasan ke apne anubhavon ke aadhaar par 'Indica' naam ki pustak likhi. Usi vivaran se hume pata chalta hai ki Pataliputra ke aas-paas lakdi ka bada parkot (rampart), khai tatha 570 burj the, tatha prashasan me 'sachiv', 'amatyas', 'nagar-adhyaksha' jaise adhikari the. Seleucus khud shasak the, isliye 'dutak' nahi; Kautilya/Chanakya Chandragupta ke mantri tatha 'Arthashastra' ke lekhak the; Dionysius ek anya yunanee lekhar the. Exam point: 'Indica' ke lekhak = Megasthenes (Seleucus Nicator ke duta), Chandragupta Maurya ne Seleucus ko 303 BCE ke aas-paas hara kar sandhi ki; Arthashastra ke lekhak = Kautilya.

qe: The Barabar caves, the oldest surviving rock-cut caves in India, were gifted by Emperor Ashoka to which religious sect?
qh: भारत की प्राचीनतम विद्यमान शैलकृत गुफाएँ बराबर की गुफाएँ सम्राट अशोक ने किस धार्मिक संप्रदाय को दान की थीं?
e: Barabar hills (Makhdumpur block, Jehanabad jila, Phalgu nadi ke nikat) me chaar mukhya gufayein hain - Lomas Rishi, Sudama, Visvakarma tatha Karna Chaupar. Inhe Mauryan samrat Ashoka ne apne shasan ke 12vein tatha 19vein varsh me banwaya tatha 'Ajivika' sampraday ke tapasviyon ko daan kiya; unke potra Dasharatha ne aage Nagarjuni pahaadi ki gufayein (Gopi, Vadathika tatha Vapiyaka) isi parampara ko arpit ki. Yeh gufayein eenton se nahi balki ek hi thos granite chattan ko bheetar se khod kar banayi gayi hain, isliye yeh bharat ki rock-cut architecture ki janm-datri maani jaati hain. Inme Lomas Rishi gufa ka hathi-mukhi darwaze ka frieze tatha Maurya kaal ki darpan-jaisi polish buri tarah jaani jaati hai. Yahi kala aage Ajanta, Ellora tatha Karle ki gufaon me viksit hui. Isliye 'Ajivika' hi sahi uttar hai; Mahayana, Svetambara tatha Kapalika sampraday baad ke daur ke nahi kehlate. Exam point: Barabar gufayein = Jehanabad, Ashoka dwara Ajivika sampraday ko daan, Lomas Rishi gufa ka frieze; Dasharatha dwara banwayi Nagarjuni gufayein.

qe: The First Buddhist Council was held at Rajgriha under the patronage of Ajatashatru, while the Second Buddhist Council was held at which place?
qh: प्रथम बौद्ध संगीति अजातशत्रु के संरक्षण में राजगृह में हुई, तो द्वितीय बौद्ध संगीति कहाँ हुई?
e: Gautam Buddha ke Mahaparinirvana (lagbhag 483 ee. poo.) ke baad unke updeshon ko surakshit rakhne ke liye pratham Buddhist sangiti Rajgriha me Sattapanni gufa me hui; iski adhyakshta Mahakassapa ne ki tatha raja Ajatashatru ne sanrakshan diya. Isi sangiti me Buddha ke updesh teen pitakon me baante gaye - Vinaya Pitaka (bhikshuon ke niyam), Sutta Pitaka (updesh) tatha Abhidhamma Pitaka (gahra darshan). Lagbhag sau saal baad Vaishali me doosri sangiti hui, jiski adhyakshta Vasupala tatha Revata ki sahayata se Yasa ne ki; iske sanrakshak raja Kalashoka the. Is sangiti ka mukhya kaaran Vajji ke bhikshuon dwara 'das vastukathayein' (jaise sona-chandi rakhna, do waqt khana) ke roop me dhile niyam apnana tha, jise purava bhikshuon ne mana kar diya. Pataliputra me teesri sangiti Ashoka ke samay me hui (lagbhag 250 ee. poo.), jabki Kushinagar Buddha ke Mahaparinirvana ka sthal hai, sangiti ka nahi. Exam point: Pratham sangiti = Rajgriha (Ajatashatru ke samay, Sattapanni gufa), Dwitiya = Vaishali (Kalashoka ke samay), Tritiya = Pataliputra (Ashoka ke samay).

qe: Vaishali, the capital of the Vajji confederacy, is known as the world's first republic and was the home of the famous courtesan:
qh: वज्जि संघ की राजधानी वैशाली विश्व की प्रथम गणतंत्र मानी जाती है तथा प्रसिद्ध नगर-वधू कौन थी?
e: Vaishali (aaj Vaishali jila) Vajji sangh ki rajdhani thi tatha Lichchhavi ganarajya ka mukhya kendra. Yahan raja ko vansh-parampara nahi balki chunav tatha sabha ke faislon se niyukt kiya jaata tha, isliye ise duniya ka pehla ganatantra (republic) maana jaata hai. Yahan ki rajkiya vyavastha me 'gana' aur 'sangha' jeise sangathan the jo aaj ke loktantrik system ke puraane udaharan hain. Vaishali ki prasiddh nagar-vadhu (ganika) Amrapali thi, jisne Buddh ke updesh sune tatha baad me bhikkhuni (sanyasin) ban kar dhamma ko apnaya. Vaishali me Bhagwan Mahavira ka janm Kundagrama (Kundalpur) me hua, tatha buddhist parampara me yahin Buddha ne apna aakhri updesh diya aur yahin se unki Mahaparinirvana yatra Kushinagar ke liye shuru hui; Ashoka ka sinha-stambh bhi yahan milta hai tatha doosri sangiti bhi yahin hui. Kamaladevi, Vishakha aur Mahapajapati anya aakhyan-gathaon se jude naam hain, isliye woh sahi vikalp nahi. Exam point: Vaishali = Vajji/Lichchhavi ganarajya ki rajdhani, duniya ka pehla ganatantra; Amrapali yahan ki nagar-vadhu thi, Mahavira ka janm Kundagrama (Vaishali) me; Ashoka stambh tatha dwitiya sangiti bhi yahin.

qe: Which Gupta ruler founded the Nalanda Mahavihara, which was declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2016?
qh: किस गुप्त शासक ने नालंदा महाविहार की स्थापना की, जिसे 2016 में यूनेस्को विश्व धरोहर स्थल घोषित किया गया?
e: Nalanda Mahavihara ki neev 5vein sadi (lagbhag 427 ee.) me Gupta shasak Kumargupta I ne rakhi; unhe Mahendraditya ya Shakraditya bhi kaha jaata hai. Yah vishva ka pehla bada avasiya (residential) antarrashtriya vishwavidyalaya maana jaata hai, jahan 10,000 tak chhatra tatha 2,000 shikshak padhte-padhaate the; China ke traveller Xuanzang (Hiuen Tsang) aur I-tsing ne iska vistrit varnan kiya. Aage Kannauj ke Harshavardhana tatha Pala shasakon ne iska bahut vistar kiya. Hamlaa mein 1193 ee. me Bakhtiyar Khalji ki sena ne Nalanda aur Odantapuri ko ujjar diya, jisse yah gyan-kendra khatam ho gaya. Vartaman Bharat Sharif (Nalanda jila) ke Bada Gaon me iske khandaher mile hain; 2016 me UNESCO ne ise World Heritage Site ghoshit kiya. Samudragupta tatha Chandragupta II Nalanda ke sansthapak nahi maane jaate, isliye woh vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: Nalanda ke sansthapak = Kumargupta I (Shakraditya), 2016 me UNESCO World Heritage Site, 1193 ee. me Bakhtiyar Khalji dwara vinash; Xuanzang aur I-tsing ne iska varnan kiya.

qe: The Kesariya Stupa, regarded as the tallest ancient stupa in the world, is located in which district?
qh: विश्व का सबसे ऊँचा प्राचीन स्तूप माना जाने वाला केसरिया स्तूप किस जिले में स्थित है?
e: Kesariya stupa East Champaran jile ke Kesariya me Gandak bassein me sthit hai. Buddhist parampara me Bhagwan Buddha ne Vaishali se Kushinagar ki apni aakhri yatra shuru ki thi; Vaishali ke Lichchhavi log unhe chhodne door tak aaye, aur jahan unhe alvida kaha wahan Lichchhaviyon ne unki smriti me ek stupa banwaya - yahi Kesariya stupa hai. Aaj yah lagbhag 104 foot (lagbhag 31.7 meter) uncha hai tatha Bahubali ke mandir ke itihas ke kaaran 'Bihar ka Borobudur' bhi kaha jaata hai. 1934 ke bhaakamp se pehle iski unchai aur bhi zyada maani jaati thi, isliye ise Indonesia ke prasiddh Borobudur se uncha bataya jaata hai. 1998 me ASI ki khudai ke baad yah duniya ke saamne aaya. Muzaffarpur, Bhagalpur tatha Saran me aise koi vishva-prasiddh ancien stupa nahi hai, isliye woh vikalp galat hain. Exam point: Kesariya stupa = East Champaran, duniya ka sabse uncha mana jaane wala ancient stupa (karib 104 foot), Lichchhaviyon dwara Buddha ki smriti me nirmit.

qe: The Pashupata sect of Shaivism, which had followers in Bihar, was founded by which teacher?
qh: शैव धर्म का पाशुपत संप्रदाय, जिसके अनुयायी बिहार में भी थे, किस आचार्य द्वारा स्थापित माना जाता है?
e: Shaiv mat ke ek pramukh sampraday 'Pashupata' sampraday ki sthapna parampara me Lakulisha naam ke acharya ne ki tatha unke naam par 'Lakulisha' ki murtiyan bhi banti rahi. Bihar me bhi is sampraday ke anuyayi the; Narayanapala ke Bhagalpur plate (tamba-patra abhilekh) me Pashupata sampraday ka zikr milta hai tatha Chotanagpur ke kshetra (Benisagar) ki khudai me Lakulisha ki murti bhi mili hai. Lakulisha ke anuyayi apne shareer par vibhuti/bhasm lagate the tatha Shivling ki puja tatha tapasya par zor dete the; Shaiv mat ke saath-saath Shakti (Devi) tatha Vaishnav mat bhi Bihar me lokpriya the. Shankaracharya ne Advait Vedant ka prachar kiya, Ramanuja ne Vishishtadvait tatha Basava ne Lingayat mat ka - isliye sahi uttar Lakulisha hai. Exam point: Pashupata sampraday ke sansthapak = Lakulisha; Bihar me iska pramaan Narayanapala ke Bhagalpur plate (tamba-patra) tatha Singhbhum (Benisagar) me mili Lakulisha ki murti se milta hai.

qe: Sapta-matrika images found in Bihar represent the worship of which group of deities?
qh: बिहार में मिली सप्त-मातृका प्रतिमाएँ किस देवी-समूह की पूजा को दर्शाती हैं?
e: Sapta-matrika ka arth hai saat matrikayein yaani saat deviyan; inhe saat pramukh devtaon ki shaktiyan maana jaata hai tatha prachin kaal me Bihar tatha anya kshetraon me inki puja ka prachalan tha. Bihar me Ganesh, Kartikeya (Skanda) tatha Devi (Durga/Uma) ki anek murtiyan mili hain tatha 'Mahishamardini' (mahishasur ka vadh karti Durga) ki bhi anek pratimayein prapt hui hain; yeh sab Shakti tatha Saiv upasana ke lokpriya hone ke pramaan hain. Devi ki puja me maa ke aage bali tatha vishesh sanskar ki parampara bhi milti hai, jise baad me sanyam tatha saumya puja ke roop me badalne ki koshish hui. Sapta rishi, saat nadiyan tatha saat grah alag avdharnayein hain - isliye sahi uttar saat matri-deviyan hain. Exam point: Sapta-matrika = saat matri deviyan, jo saat devtaon ki shaktiyan maani jaati hain; Bihar me Mahishamardini tatha Devi ki anek pratimayein mili hain, jo Shakti upasana ke pramaan hain.

qe: The Vishnupada temple of Gaya is known because inside it there is a preserved footprint of which deity?
qh: गया का विष्णुपद मंदिर किस देवता के संरक्षित चरण-चिह्न के लिए प्रसिद्ध है?
e: Gaya ka Vishnupada mandir us sthal par bana hai jahan parampara me Bhagwan Vishnu ka charan-chinh (pairon ka nishaan) patthar par aankit hai; yahi mandir Vishnu ki upasana ka bada kendra raha tatha aaj bhi yatree yahan pind-daan tatha shraddh ke liye aate hain. is mandir ke prangan se mila ek abhilekh Narayanapala ke saatvein rajya-varsh ka hai tatha usme 'Purushottama' yaani Vishnu ka dhyaan kiya gaya hai; mandir ke neeche ki slab par Vashudev (Vishnu) ki stuti wala abhilekh bhi mila jo Govindapala ke samay ka maana jaata hai. Isi kshetra me Anantasayi Vishnu ki murti bhi hai jisme Vishnu Lakshmi ki god me apne charan rakhe dikhte hain; yeh sab pramaan dikhate hain ki Gaya kshetra me Vishnu-bhakti poori tarah jami hui thi. Shiv, Surya tatha Ganesh ki bhi murtiyan Bihar me mili hain, lekin Vishnupada mandir ka charan-chinh Vishnu ka hai - isliye sahi uttar Vishnu hai. Exam point: Vishnupada mandir (Gaya) = Vishnu ke charan-chinh wala mandir, Pitrapaksha me pind-daan ka kendra; mandir ke abhilekh Pala shasak Narayanapala tatha Govindapala ke samay ke hain.

qe: The famous hoard of Pala-period bronze images, including that of Balarama, was discovered at which site in Gaya district?
qh: पाल कालीन कांस्य मूर्तियों का प्रसिद्ध कोष, जिसमें बलराम की मूर्ति भी शामिल है, गया जिले के किस स्थल से मिला?
e: Kurkihar Gaya jile ka woh sthal hai jahan se Pala kaal ki kansya (bronze) murtiyon ka bada bhandar mila; inme Balarama yaani Haladhar (Vishnu ka satva avtar maana jane wala) ki murtiyan bhi shaamil hain, jo aaj kai sangrahalayon me rakhi hain. Pala shasak kala ke bade sanrakshak the; unke samay me patthar, kansya tatha mitti ki murtiyon me Vishnu, Shiv, Devi, Buddha tatha Bodhisattva ki aakritiyan banai gayi tatha Nalanda tatha Vikramshila ke mahaviharon se in murtiyon ko desh-videsh bhejne ka kaam bhi hota tha, isliye Pala kala desh ke bahar bhi pahunchi. Kurkihar ki murtiyon me tin ke saath-saath sone-chandi ke patle aavaran bhi dikhte hain, jo us samay ki dhatu-shilp ki uchch kaushal ko dikhate hain. Konch tatha Ramgaya kshetra se bhi Vishnu tatha avtar sambandhi avashesh mile hain, lekin kansya murtiyon ka prasiddh bhandar Kurkihar ka hi hai - isliye sahi uttar Kurkihar hai. Exam point: Kurkihar (Gaya jila) = Pala kaal ki kansya murtiyon ka prasiddh bhandar, jisme Balarama ki murtiyan bhi; Pala kala Nalanda-Vikramshila ke madhyam se videsh tak pahunchi.

qe: The Tibetan scholar Dharmaswami, who visited Bihar in 1232-34, noted that out of about eighty Buddhist monasteries how many were still in a serviceable condition?
qh: तिब्बती विद्वान धर्मस्वामी ने, जिन्होंने 1232-34 में बिहार का भ्रमण किया, बताया कि लगभग अस्सी बौद्ध विहारों में से कितने अभी उपयोग-योग्य थे?
e: 1232 se 1234 ke beech tibbati vidwan Dharmaswami ne Bihar ka bhraman kiya tatha apne vivaran me likha ki yahan Brahmanical (Vishnu-Shiv-Devi ki puja karne wale) upasak bahusankhyak the jabki Bauddh log alp-sankhyak the. Unhone bataya ki lagbhag 80 Bauddh viharon me se sirf do hi theek halat me kaam-laayak bache the - yahi baat dikhati hai ki Pala shasan ke ant tak Nalanda-Vikramshila jaisi sansthaon ki chamak ke baad 13vein sadi me Bauddh dharm ka prabhav bahut ghat gaya tha. Unhone yah bhi likha ki Bodh Gaya (Vajrasana) ke bikhshuon ne Buddha ki murti ko non-Buddhist hamlon se bachane ke liye uske saamne Shiv ki murti laga di thi. Aise vivaran isliye mahatvapurn hain kyunki videshi yatri ke aankhon-dekhe varnan se hum us daur ki dharmik sthiti samajh paate hain. Isliye sahi uttar 'keval do' hai. Exam point: Dharmaswami (tibbati vidwan, 1232-34) ne likha ki lagbhag 80 Bauddh viharon me se sirf 2 kaam-laayak bache the; unke samay Brahmanical upasak bahusankhyak tatha Bauddh alp-sankhyak the; Bodh Gaya me Shiv ki murti Buddha ki murti ke aage rakhne ka ullekh bhi unhone kiya.

qe: The bronze image of the Buddha found at Sultanganj in Bhagalpur district is now kept in a museum of which country?
qh: भागलपुर जिले के सुल्तानगंज से मिली बुद्ध की कांस्य प्रतिमा अब किस देश के संग्रहालय में रखी है?
e: Sultanganj (Bhagalpur jila) me Ganga kinare khudai ke dauran Buddha ki ek vishal kansya (bronze) murti mili; yah lagbhag saade do meter unchi hai tatha ise Gupta kaal ki dhatu-murti-kala ka uttam namuna maana jaata hai, kyunki iske rang-roop tatha bhav-bhangima achhe se bachi hui hai. Yeh murti baad me Britain le jai gayi tatha aaj wahan ke Birmingham Museum me rakhi hai; isi tarah Pala kaal ki kai kansya murtiyan Nepal, Tibet tatha anya deshon ke sangrahalayon me bhi pahunchi, kyunki unke grahak yatree tatha Raja the. Aisi murtiyon ka Bihar se bahar jaana yah dikhata hai ki prachin Bihar ki kala desh ki seema se bhi aage prasiddh thi tatha uski maang rahi. France, Japan tatha Thailand ke sangrahalayon me bhi Bharatiya kala hai, lekin Sultanganj ki Buddha pratima ke liye sahi uttar Britain hai. Exam point: Sultanganj (Bhagalpur) ki kansya Buddha murti = Gupta kaal ki dhatu-kala ka uttam namuna, aaj Britain ke Birmingham Museum me; Pala kaal ki murtiyan Tibet-Nepal tatha anya deshon me bhi pahunchi.

qe: The Mundeshwari Devi temple, counted among the oldest surviving temples of India, is located in which district of Bihar?
qh: भारत के सबसे प्राचीन जीवित मंदिरों में गिना जाने वाला मुंडेश्वरी देवी मंदिर बिहार के किस जिले में स्थित है?
e: Mundeshwari Devi mandir Kaimur jile me Ramgarh (Chainpur) pahadi par sthit hai tatha ise bharat ke sabse purane kaam karte hue mandiron me ginta jaata hai; iski sthapna-parampara bahut prachin maani jaati hai tatha mandir me Devi ki murti ke saath Shiv tatha anya devtaon ki pratimayein bhi hain. Is mandir ka zikr purane abhilekhon tatha chitron me milta hai, jisse pata chalta hai ki yah kshetra Pala-Pratihar kaal me dharmik tatha kalatmak roop se sakriya tha. Isi jile me Mundeshwari ke alawa Kaimur Wildlife Sanctuary tatha isi jile me Kaimur van-kshetra tatha Adhaura-Bhabhua ke jangal bhi hain, isliye Kaimur dharmik tatha prakritik dono drishti se mahatvapurn hai. Nalanda (Mahavihara), Gaya (Bodh Gaya) tatha Rohtas (Rohtasgarh kila) bhi bade kendra hain, lekin Mundeshwari Devi mandir Kaimur me hai - isliye sahi uttar Kaimur hai. Exam point: Mundeshwari Devi mandir = Kaimur jila (Ramgarh/Chainpur pahadi), bharat ke sabse purane kaam karte mandiron me ginta jaata hai; Kaimur jila Kaimur Wildlife Sanctuary ke liye bhi jaana jaata hai.

qe: The mausoleums of Malik Ibrahim Baya at Bihar Sharif and of Shah Daulat at Maner belong to which architectural tradition?
qh: बिहार शरीफ में मलिक इब्राहिम बाया तथा मनेर में शाह दौलत की मजारें किस स्थापत्य परंपरा से संबंधित हैं?
oe: Indo-Islamic tomb architecture of medieval Bihar
oh: मध्यकालीन बिहार की इंडो-इस्लामिक मकबरा-स्थापत्य परंपरा
e: Bihar Sharif me Malik Ibrahim Baya ki mazar tatha Maner me Shah Daulat ki mazar madhyakaleen Bihar ke sufi-sthapatya ke prasiddh namune hain; in mazaron par gumbad, mehrab-dar darwaze tatha sajavat ke liye rangin tile-kaari dekhne ko milti hai, isliye yah Indo-Islamic tomb architecture ke udaharan kehlate hain. Maner tatha Bihar Sharif dono sufi kshetra the: Maner me Shah Daulat ki dargah tatha Bihar Sharif me Makhdum Sharfuddin Yahiya Maneri (Makhdoom-ul-Mulk) ka asthana tha, isliye yahan dharmik tatha sanskritik gatividhiyan chalti thi tatha alim aur kavi aate-jaate the. Aise kshetron ke aas-paas bazaar, khanqah tatha madarse bhi base, isliye shahar ka vikas hua. Bauddh stupa, Nagara mandir tatha colonial architecture alag paramparaen hain - isliye sahi uttar Indo-Islamic mazara-sthapatya hai. Exam point: Malik Ibrahim Baya ki mazar (Bihar Sharif) tatha Shah Daulat ki mazar (Maner) = Indo-Islamic tomb architecture; dono kshetra sufi parampara ke kendra, jahan dargah, khanqah tatha bazaar ek saath base.

qe: In which holy city of Bihar did Buddhist monks place a Shiva image in front of the Buddha image to protect it?
qh: बिहार के किस पवित्र स्थल पर बौद्ध भिक्षुओं ने बुद्ध की मूर्ति को हमले से बचाने के लिए उसके सामने शिव की मूर्ति लगाई थी?
e: Tibbati vidwan Dharmaswami ne 1232-34 ke apne bhraman-vivaran me likha ki Bodh Gaya (Vajrasana) ke bikhshuon ne Buddha ki murti ko non-Buddhist hamlon se bachane ke liye uske saamne Shiv ki murti laga di thi, taaki hamlavar samjhein ki yahan Shiv ki puja hoti hai tatha murti ko chhod dein. Yah ghatna us daur ki sthiti dikhati hai jab Bauddh dharm ka prabhav kam ho gaya tha tatha Brahmanical tatha Tantrik upasana bahusankhyak ho gayi thi; usi samay Magadha me Tantrik matri-devi ke liye 300 bhainson tatha 300 bojh dhan ki bali dene ka bhi zikr milta hai. Aise varnan videshi yatri ke prayan se milte hain, isliye woh aitihasik pramaan ke roop me bahut upyogi hote hain. Rajgir, Nalanda tatha Vaishali bhi Bauddh itihas ke bade kendra hain, lekin Shiv ki murti Buddha ki murti ke aage rakhne ka ullekh Bodh Gaya ke liye hai - isliye sahi uttar Bodh Gaya hai. Exam point: Bodh Gaya ke bikhshuon dwara Buddha murti ke aage Shiv murti rakhne ka ullekh tibbati vidwan Dharmaswami (1232-34) ke vivaran me milta hai; us daur me Bauddh dharm ka prabhav ghat chuka tha tatha Brahmanical-Tantrik upasana bahusankhyak thi.

qe: Who founded the Pala dynasty around 750 CE, ending the state of 'Matsyanyaya' (lawlessness) in Bengal-Bihar, and founded the Odantapuri Mahavihara?
qh: लगभग 750 ईस्वी में पाल वंश की स्थापना किसने की, जिसने बंग-बिहार में 'मत्स्यन्याय' (अराजकता) समाप्त की तथा ओदंतपुरी महाविहार बनवाया?
e: Gopala Pala vansh ke sansthapak the; unhe lok-pratinidhiyon (praja ke pramukhon) dwara chun kar raja banaya gaya, isliye Pala rajyashakti ko 'chunav se aayi satta' ka ek puraana udaharan maana jaata hai. Us samay Bengal-Bihar me 'Matsyanyaya' chal raha tha, yaani bade machhli chhoti machhli ko kha jaati hai - iska arth tha ki shaktishali log kamzor praja ka shoshan kar rahe the aur koi kendra-shasan nahi tha. Gopala ne ise khatm kiya tatha shanti tatha vyavastha sthapit ki. Unhone Odantapuri Mahavihara ki sthapna ki, jo Magadha (aaj Bihar Sharif ke nikat) me ek bada Buddhist gyan-kendra tha. Pala shasakon ne Nalanda tatha Vikramshila ka bhi vistar kiya tatha Sanskrit tatha Buddhist vidya ko sanrakshan diya. Dharmapala tatha Devapala Gopala ke baad ke shasak the (Dharmapala ne Vikramshila tatha Somapura banwaya), tatha Nanyadeva Mithila ke Karnat vansh ke sansthapak the. Exam point: Pala vansh ke sansthapak = Gopala (lagbhag 750 ee.), 'Matsyanyaya' ka ant, Odantapuri Mahavihara unke naam se juda; Dharmapala ne Vikramshila tatha Somapura banwaya.

qe: Vikramshila Mahavihara, a great centre of Vajrayana Buddhism, was established by which Pala ruler at Antichak in Bhagalpur district?
qh: वज्रयान बौद्ध धर्म का महान केंद्र विक्रमशिला महाविहार भागलपुर जिले के अंतिचक में किस पाल शासक ने स्थापित किया?
e: Dharmapala Pala vansh ke sabse shaktishali shasak the; unhe 'Uttarapathasvamin' (uttar ke path ke swami) tatha 'Paramasaugata' (Buddh ke param bhakt) kaha gaya. Unhone Vikramshila Mahavihara ki sthapna ki, jo Bhagalpur jile ke Antichak me sthit tha aur Vajrayana tatha Tantric buddh dharm ka sabse bada kendra bana. Yah vishwavidyalaya ek pahaadi par bana tha tatha iska apna prashasan, granthalay tatha aavasiya (hostel) vyavastha thi; yahan Tibet, Nepal tatha anya deshon ke bhi vidyarthi padhte the. Isi Vikramshila ke mahasthavira (pramukh acharya) Atisha Dipankara Srijnana the, jinhone 11vein sadi me Tibet ja kar buddh dharm ka doosra prachar kiya. Gopala vansh ke sansthapak the tatha Odantapuri unse juda; Mahipala tatha Rampala baad ke Pala shasak the. Isliye is prashn ka sahi uttar Dharmapala hai. Exam point: Vikramshila Mahavihara = Dharmapala dwara sthapit, Antichak (Bhagalpur), Vajrayana ka mukhya kendra; iske acharya Atisha Dipankara ne Tibet me buddh dharm ka prachar kiya.

qe: Atisha Dipankara Srijnana, who re-established Buddhism in Tibet, was the head (Mahasthavira) of which Bihar monastery?
qh: तिब्बत में बौद्ध धर्म का पुनः प्रचार करने वाले अतीश दीपंकर श्रीज्ञान किस बिहार-स्थित महाविहार के प्रमुख (महास्थविर) थे?
e: Atisha Dipankara Srijnana (janm 982 ee., Bengal) ek mahan Buddhist acharya the; woh Vikramshila Mahavihara ke Mahasthavira (sabse bada pramukh acharya) the. Tibet ke raja ne unhe aamantrit kiya aur woh 1042 ee. me Tibet gaye, jahan unhone sangh ko sudhar kar buddh dharm ki 'doosri prachar' (Second Propagation) chalai; isi karan unhe 'Tibet ke Bodhisattva' kaha jaata hai. Unhone wahan 'Bodhipathapradipa' jaisi granth likhi tatha sangh-vyavastha ko naya dhange se khada kiya; isi parampara se aage Tibetan buddh dharm ka vikas hua. Nalanda (Nalanda jila) tatha Odantapuri (Bihar Sharif ke nikat) bhi bade mahavihara the, lekin Atisha ka mukhya pad Vikramshila me hi tha; Somapura (aaj Bangladesh me Paharpur) Dharmapala dwara banwaya gaya tha. Isliye vikalp 'Vikramshila' sahi hai. Exam point: Atisha Dipankara = Vikramshila ke Mahasthavira, 1042 ee. me Tibet gaye, wahan buddh dharm ki doosri prachar ki; unhone Bodhipathapradipa likhi.

qe: The Karnat dynasty of Mithila, which ruled from Simraungadh, was founded in 1097 CE by:
qh: सिमरावनगढ़ से शासन करने वाले मिथिला के कर्नाट वंश की स्थापना 1097 ईस्वी में किसने की?
e: Nanyadeva ne 1097 ee. ke aas-paas Mithila me Karnat vansh ki sthapna ki; unhone Simraungadh (aaj Nepal ke Bara jila kshetra) ko apni rajdhani banaya. Isi vansh ne Mithila me sthir prashasan tatha Sanskrit-Maithili vidya ko protsahit kiya. Nanyadeva ne 'Bharata-Bhashya' jaisi kriti likhi, jisme sangeet shastra ka vishleshan hai, isliye woh sangeet ke vidwan shasak ke roop me bhi jaane jaate hain. Harisimhadeva isi vansh ke baad ke mahatvapurn shasak the, jinhone Maithil Brahmanon aur Karna Kayasthon ki jati-vyavastha ki jankari 'Panji Prabandha' me record karwai. Chandeshvara Thakkura Karnat kaalon ke sandhivigrahika (shanti-yuddh mantri) tatha dharmadhaksh the, jabki Vidyapati Karnat ke baad Oiniwar kaalon ke rajdarbari kavi the. Isliye Karnat vansh ke sansthapak ke roop me Nanyadeva hi sahi hain. Exam point: Karnat vansh (Mithila) = sansthapak Nanyadeva (1097 ee.), rajdhani Simraungadh; Nanyadeva ne Bharata-Bhashya likhi; Harisimhadeva ne 'Panji Prabandha' vyavastha chalu ki.

qe: The 'Panji Prabandha', a unique genealogical register of Maithil families, was introduced at the instance of which Karnat king?
qh: मैथिल परिवारों का अनूठा वंशावली-अभिलेख 'पंजी प्रबंध' किस कर्नाट शासक के समय आरंभ किया गया?
e: 'Panji Prabandha' Mithila ki ek anokhi vyavastha hai jisme Maithil Brahmanon tatha Karna Kayasthon ke vansh, vivaah tatha gotra ka likhit record rakha chalta hai. Iske shuru karne ka shrey Karnat shasak Harisimhadeva ko diya jaata hai, jinhone 14vein sadi (karib 1324 ee.) me is vyavastha ko sansthapik roop diya tatha 'Panjikar' (record rakhne wale) niyukt kiye. Iska mukhya uddeshya tha ki vivaah me ek hi khand ke andar rishta na ho tatha jati-vyavastha suvyavasthit rahe; aaj bhi Mithila me vivaah se pehle panji dekhi jaati hai. Yah vyavastha Mithila ki samajik sanstha ka aisa udaharan hai jo saat sau saal se chalta aa raha hai. Nanyadeva Karnat vansh ke sansthapak the (Panji unke samay se pehle nahi thi), Chandeshvara Thakkura unke mantri the, tatha Shiva Singh Oiniwar vansh ke raja the jinke darbar me Vidyapati the. Exam point: 'Panji Prabandha' = Harisimhadeva (Karnat vansh, karib 1324 ee.), Maithil Brahman-Karna Kayasth vanshavali ka likhit record, Panjikar dwara sanrakshit.

qe: Makhdoom Sharfuddin Yahya Maneri, the great Sufi saint buried at Maner Sharif (Patna), belonged to which Sufi order?
qh: मनेर शरीफ (पटना) में दफ़्न महान सूफी संत मख़दूम शर्फ़ुद्दीन यह्या मनेरी किस सूफी सिलसिले से थे?
e: Makhdoom Sharfuddin Ahmed Yahya Maneri (Maner, Patna) 13vein-14vein sadi ke mahan Sufi sant the tatha bharat me Firdausi silsile ke sarvocch acharya maane jaate hain; unhe 'Makhdoom-ul-Mulk' tatha 'Bihar ke Sufi sant' kaha jaata hai. Unke pita Makhdoom Yahya Maneri tatha unke apne chele tatha santan ne Bihar me Sufi parampara ko phailaya. Unki mashhoor kitaab 'Maktubat-i-Sadi' (sau khaton ka sangrah) hai, jisme unhi ne apne shishyon ko aise khat likhe jo aaj bhi Sufi shiksha ki aadarsh pustakein maane jaate hain; isme insaani mohabbat, sadgi tatha atma-sudhar ke updesh hain. Maner Sharif me unka mazaar 'Bari Dargah' ke naam se prasiddh hai, jahan 1216 ee. ke aas-paas yeh sansthan Bihar ka pehla bada Sufi kendra bana. Chishti, Suhrawardi tatha Naqshbandi anya Sufi silsile hain (Chishti: Ajmer ke Khwaja Moinuddin; Suhrawardi: Multan-Baghdad se jude; Naqshbandi: Khwaja Baqi Billah ke baad bharat me), isliye Bihar ke Maner ka Firdausi silsila hi sahi hai. Exam point: Maner Sharif, Patna = Firdausi silsile ke Makhdoom Yahya Maneri ka kendra; unki kriti 'Maktubat-i-Sadi'; Bari Dargah (Maner) Bihar ki Sufi parampara ka prateek.

qe: Which new silver coin introduced by Sher Shah Suri became the base of the modern rupee, and where is his tomb 'the Taj Mahal of Bihar' located?
qh: शेरशाह सूरी द्वारा चलाया गया कौन-सा चाँदी का नया सिक्का आधुनिक रुपए का आधार बना, तथा 'बिहार का ताजमहल' कहे जाने वाला उनका मकबरा कहाँ है?
e: Sher Shah Suri (asli naam Farid Khan, janm Sasaram, Rohtas) ne 1540 me Sur samrajya ki sthapna ki. Unhone apne shasan me chandi ka naya sikka 'Rupiya' chala, jiska vazan thik 178 gran (178 grain) tha - yahi naam aage 'rupee' ke roop me badla; sone ka 'Mohur' tatha tambe ka 'Dam' bhi unke sikkon ke naam the. Iske alava unhone 'Sadak-e-Azam' (Grand Trunk Road) ko sudhar kar Peshawar se Sonargaon tak pavitra raah banai, harkaravan saraay (dharamshala) banwaye, dak-vyavastha chalaun tatha zameen ki pemaish ka naya tarika apnaya. Unka makbara Sasaram (Rohtas) me ek artificial jheel (artificial lake) ke beech me bana hai, isliye ise 'Bihar ka Taj Mahal' tatha 'Sasaram ka Taza' kaha jaata hai; makbara us tak teen darjon se pahuncha jaata hai. Unki mrityu 1545 me Kalinjar ke kilay par hamle ke dauraan hui. Mohur (sone ka sikka) tatha Dam (tambe ka sikka) bhi Sher Shah ke hi sikkon ke naam the, par unke saath diye gaye sthal galat hain; isliye Rupiya tatha Sasaram ki jodi hi sahi hai. Exam point: Sher Shah dwara chala chandi ka sikka = Rupiya (178 grain), sone ka = Mohur, tambe ka = Dam; unka makbara Sasaram (Rohtas) ki jheel ke beech, 'Bihar ka Taj Mahal'; Grand Trunk Road (Sadak-e-Azam) unse juda.

qe: The Battle of Chausa (1539), in which Sher Shah Suri defeated Humayun, was fought in which district of Bihar?
qh: 1539 का चौसा का युद्ध, जिसमें शेरशाह सूरी ने हुमायूँ को हराया, बिहार के किस जिले में लड़ा गया था?
e: 26 June 1539 ko Chausa (aaj Buxar jila) me Sher Shah Suri ne Mughal samrat Humayun ko parajit kiya; is jite ke baad unke liye Bengal tatha Bihar ka rasta khul gaya. Sher Shah ne pehle Chunar kila chinh liya, phir Bihar kshetra me apni satta majboot ki tatha Chausa ke yuddh me Mughal sena ko ghere hue Ganga ke kinare hara diya. Iske baad 1540 me Kannauj ke yuddh (Bilgram) me Humayun ko poori tarah hara kar Sher Shah poore uttar bharat ka shaasak ban gaya. Buxar ka naam ek aur bade yuddh ke liye bhi jaana jaata hai - 1764 ke Buxar ke yuddh me British East India Company ne Mir Qasim, Shuja-ud-Daula tatha Shah Alam II ki sanyukt sena ko hara kar bharat me apna rajniti prastha banaya. Rohtas Chausa se alag jila hai, tatha Bhagalpur tatha Begusarai in do yuddhon se jude nahi hain. Exam point: Chausa ka yuddh (26 June 1539, Buxar jila) = Sher Shah Suri dwara Humayun ki parajay; 1764 ka Buxar yuddh = British dwara Mir Qasim-Shuja-ud-Daula-Shah Alam II ki sanyukt sena ki parajay.

qe: Which invader destroyed the Nalanda and Odantapuri monasteries around 1193 CE, ending Nalanda's glory as a university?
qh: किस हमलावर ने 1193 ईस्वी के आसपास नालंदा तथा ओदंतपुरी विहारों को नष्ट किया, जिससे नालंदा की विश्वविद्यालय-प्रतिष्ठा समाप्त हो गई?
e: Bakhtiyar Khalji (Ikhtiyaruddin Muhammad Bakhtiyar Khalji) 1200 ee. ke aas-paas Bihar tatha Bengal par hamla karne wala Gori ka senapati tha; usne Nalanda Mahavihara tatha Odantapuri Mahavihara ko lutt kar jalakar khatm kar diya aur wahan ke bhikshuon ko maar diya. Isi hamle ke baad Nalanda ka gyan-kendra ka roop khatm ho gaya tatha vahan ka grantha-bhandar jalaa diya gaya. Iska bare me tibbati traveller Dharmasvamin tatha anya vividh itihas-granthon me varnan milta hai. Mahmud Ghazni ne 1000-1027 ee. ke aas-paas uttar bharat par kayi hamle kiye the, par Nalanda ke vinash ka shrey Bakhtiyar Khalji ko jaata hai; Muhammad Ghori ne 1191-1192 ke Tarain yuddhon ke baad bharat me Gori satta sthapit ki, aur Timur 1398 me aaya tha. Exam point: Nalanda aur Odantapuri ka vinash (1193 ee. ke aas-paas) = Bakhtiyar Khalji; Nalanda me aaj Bihar Sharif ke nikat Bada Gaon me khandaher hain.

qe: In the account of Megasthenes, the city government of Pataliputra was in charge of how many boards of how many members each?
qh: मेगस्थनीज के वर्णन में पाटलिपुत्र की नगर-सरकार कितने मंडलों में बंटी थी, जिनमें प्रत्येक में कितने सदस्य थे?
oe: Eight boards of four members each
Six boards of five members each
Three boards of ten members each
Five boards of six members each
e: Chandragupta Maurya ke samay Pataliputra aaya yunani rajya-dut Megasthenes ne shahar tatha uske prashasan ka vistrit varnan likha, jo aage ke itihaskaron ne uddhrut kiya. Uske varnan me Pataliputra ka nagar-prashasan chhah mandalon yaani boards me banta tha tatha har mandal me pach-pach sadasya the, is tarah kul tees sadasya hote the. Har mandal ka apna nishchit kaam tha - karkhane tatha shilpi, videshi aagantuk, janm-mrityu ka panjikaran, vyapar tatha naap-taul, bane hue maal ki bikri, tatha vikray par lag. In sabhi mandalon ka samooh milkar sarkari imaratein, mandir, bazaar tatha ghaton ki vyavastha dekhta tha tatha keematon par niyantran rakhta tha. Aisa varnan dikhata hai ki us daur me Patna me ek sanchit tatha vyavasthit nagar-prashasan maujood tha. Exam point: Megasthenes ke varnan me Pataliputra ki nagar-sarkar chhah mandalon me banti thi, jisme har mandal me pach sadasya the yaani kul tees sadasya; har mandal ka kaam alag tay tha tatha ye milkar imaraton, bazaaron tatha keematon ki vyavastha dekhte the.

qe: In the account of Pataliputra's city government, which board looked after foreign visitors, finding them lodging and medical help and forwarding their property?
qh: पाटलिपुत्र की नगर-सरकार के वर्णन में विदेशी यात्रियों की देखरेख, उनके ठहरने तथा इलाज का प्रबंध और उनकी संपत्ति भेजने का काम कौन-सा मंडल करता था?
e: Megasthenes ne Pataliputra ki nagar-sarkar ke chhah mandalon ka kaam alag-alag bataya. Doosra mandal videshi aagantukon ke liye tha; woh unhe rehne ki jagah dilata tha, bimar padne par unka ilaaj karata tha, nidhan hone par unka antim sanskar karata tha tatha unki sampatti unke rishtedaron tak bhejta tha. Yah mandal yah bhi dekhata tha ki yatri shahar me khatre se bach kar aage ki yatra kar sake tatha uske liye rakshak dal bhi diya jaata tha. Is tarah ke prabandh se pata chalta hai ki Maurya-kaaleen Patna me bahari vyapariyon tatha yatriyon ki suraksha tatha suvidha ka dhyan rakha jaata tha, jo us daur ke vishal vyapar ka zaruri hissa tha. Exam point: videshi aagantukon ka pura prabandh Pataliputra ka doosra mandal dekhta tha; woh unhe rehne ki jagah, ilaaj, antim sanskar tatha sampatti bhejne ki suvidha deta tha; yah Maurya-kaaleen bahari vyapar tatha yatra ke mahatva ko dikhata hai.

qe: Which board in the city government of Pataliputra registered births and deaths, so that the government might be kept informed of the fluctuations of population?
qh: पाटलिपुत्र की नगर-सरकार का कौन-सा मंडल जन्म तथा मृत्यु का पंजीकरण करता था, जिससे सरकार को जनसंख्या के घटने-बढ़ने की जानकारी रहती थी?
e: Pataliputra ki nagar-sarkar ke teesre mandal ka kaam janm tatha mrityu ka panjikaran yaani registration tha. Strabo ne likha hai ki aisa panjikaran keval rajasv ke liye nahi hota tha, balki is uddeshya se bhi hota tha ki sarkar ko aabadi me hone wale badlav tatha uske ghatne-badhne ki jankari milti rahe. Isse sarkar apni aavashyaktaon tatha kar-vasooli ka andaza laga sakti thi. Maurya kaal me aisi vyavastha dikhati hai ki prashasan kitna sanchit tatha lekha-jokha par adharit tha; aaj bhi janaganana tatha panjikaran ka mukhya uddeshya yahi hota hai ki sarkar ko janasankhya ke badlav ka sahi gyaan rahe. Exam point: teesra mandal janm tatha mrityu ka panjikaran karta tha; Strabo ne likha ki iska ek uddeshya rajasv tatha doosra jansankhya ke badlav ki jankari dena tha; ise dekh kar Maurya-kaaleen prashasan ki lekha-jokha wali vyavastha ka pata chalta hai.

qe: Which board superintended trade, had charge of weights and measures, and saw that trade was done in public?
qh: कौन-सा मंडल व्यापार की देखरेख करता, नाप-तौल के बाट-मापों का प्रभारी था तथा यह देखता था कि व्यापार खुले रूप में हो?
e: Pataliputra ki nagar-sarkar ke chauthe mandal ka kaam vyapar tatha vanijya ki dekh-rekh tha. Iske paas naap-taul ke bataon yaani weights and measures ka poora prabhar tha tatha iska dhyan yah tha ki vyapar khule roop me ho, chhupe tareeke se nahi. Paanchva mandal bane hue maal ki bikri dekhta tha tatha is baat ka dhyan rakhta tha ki woh bhi saamne tatha khule bazaar me bike; har vyapari ko har vastu ke liye alag anujnapatra yaani license lena padta tha. Chhate mandal ko bikri par liye jane wale dasve hisse ki vasooli ka kaam saunpa gaya tha. Aise niyam dikhate hain ki Maurya kaal me vyapar me paardarshita tatha niyantran par kaafi zor diya jaata tha. Exam point: vyapar tatha naap-taul ka prabhar Pataliputra ke chauthe mandal ke paas tha; khule bazaar me vyapar karana iska mukhya kaam tha; karkhane, videshi, janm-mrityu, vyapar, bane maal ki bikri tatha lag - is tarah chhah mandalon ke kaam bante the.

qe: Which board collected a tenth of the price of articles sold in Pataliputra?
qh: पाटलिपुत्र में बिकने वाली वस्तुओं के दाम का दसवाँ हिस्सा कौन-सा मंडल वसूल करता था?
e: Pataliputra me bane hue maal ki bikri paanchve mandal ki nigrani me hoti thi; har vyapari ko har vastu ke liye alag anujnapatra lena padta tha. Bikri ke daam ka dasva hissa yaani ek dasaiyak (1/10) bhi vasoola jaata tha, aur yah vasooli chhate mandal ka kaam thi. Inhi chhah mandalon ke kul tees sadasya milkar sarkari imaratein, mandir, bazaar tatha ghaton ki vyavastha dekhte the tatha keematon par bhi niyantran rakhte the. Is tarah Maurya kaaleen Patna me vyapar par niyantran, lag-vasooli tatha upbhokta-tatha-vyapari ki suraksha teeno ka dhyan rakha jaata tha; aage ke rajvanshon me bhi aisi vyavastha ka asar dikhta hai. Exam point: vikray ke daam ka dasva hissa chhate mandal vasool karta tha; paanchva mandal bane maal ki khuli bikri dekhta tha tatha har vyapari ko har vastu ke liye anujnapatra lena padta tha; tees sadasya milkar imaraton, bazaaron tatha keematon ka prabandh karte the.

qe: The wooden palisade of Pataliputra, one gateway of which was found in excavations with a chariot wheel lying by the rampart, was made of massive logs of which wood?
qh: पाटलिपुत्र की लकड़ी की बाड़, जिसके एक दरवाज़े की खोज खुदाई में रक्षा-दीवार के पास पड़े रथ के पहिये के साथ हुई, किस पेड़ की मोटी लट्ठों से बनी थी?
e: Pataliputra shahar mitti tatha lakdi ki badi deewar se ghira hua tha. Patna ke Bulandibagh kshetra me ki gayi khudai me is lakdi ki deewar ka bada hissa tatha shahar ka ek darwaza mila, jiske paas raksha-deewar ke kinare ek prachin rath ka pahiya pada hua mila. Yah parkot mote saal ki lakdi ke latthon se bana tha, jine moti lakdi ki keel yaani wooden pegs se aapas me jakda gaya tha. Isi tarah ke lakdi ke dhanche ke nishaan Kankar Bagh road ke pashchim, Lohanipur kshetra me bhi mile. Aisi khojen batati hain ki Maurya kaaleen Patna me patthar se pehle lakdi tatha mitti se bane prachin parkot ka istemal hua tha. Exam point: Pataliputra ka lakdi ka parkot mote saal ke latthon ka tha, jo lakdi ki keelon se joda gaya tha; Bulandibagh ki khudai me parkot tatha ek darwaza mila tatha uske paas prachin rath ka pahiya mila; aise nishaan Lohanipur me bhi mile.

qe: Dr. Spooner, who excavated at Kumrahar, found part of a great stone building of Ashoka's period and compared its plan with which famous building?
qh: कुमराहार की खुदाई करने वाले डॉ. स्पूनर ने अशोक के काल की एक बड़ी पत्थर की इमारत का हिस्सा खोजा तथा उसकी योजना की तुलना किस प्रसिद्ध इमारत से की?
oe: The Hall of a Thousand Pillars at Persepolis
The palace of Nebuchadnezzar at Babylon
e: Patna ke Kumrahar kshetra me ki gayi khudai me Ashoka ke kaal ki ek badi patthar ki imarat ka hissa mila. Is khudai ka netritva Dr. Spooner ne kiya tatha unhone is imarat ki yojana ki tulna Persepolis ke 'hazaar khambhon wale hall' se ki, jise Iran ke Achaemenid shasakon ka bada darbar-ghar mana jaata hai. Ise dekh kar andaza hota hai ki Maurya kaaleen imarat-kala par bahari prabhav pada tha tatha Ashoka ne sirf dharmik stambh hi nahi, balki bade sarkari bhawan bhi banwaye. Fa Hian jaise yatriyon ne likha ki Ashoka ke mahal tatha sabha-bhawan kisi manushya ke haath se nahi, balki devtaon ke kehne par bane lagte the. Is khudai ka kaam Sir Ratan Tata ke daan se sambhav hua, lekin pani bharne ke kaaran isme badi kathinai aayi. Exam point: Kumrahar me mili Ashoka-kaaleen patthar ki imarat ki tulna Dr. Spooner ne Persepolis ke hazaar-khambhon wale hall se ki; khudai Ratan Tata ke daan se hui tatha jal-bharav ke kaaran kathinai aayi; Fa Hian ne Ashoka ke mahal ko dev-nirmit bataya.

qe: The image of the 'mendicant prince' (Bhikhna Kunwar) near Bhikhnapahari at Patna is associated with which son of Ashoka?
qh: पटना के भिखनापहाड़ी के पास 'भिखना कुँवर' (भिक्षु राजकुमार) की मूर्ति अशोक के किस पुत्र से जुड़ी मानी जाती है?
e: Patna ke Bhikhnapahari tila ke uttar-purab kinare 'Bhikhna Kunwar' yaani bhikshu rajkumar naam ki ek murti ki puja hoti hai. Is puja ko dekh kar vidwan maante hain ki yah Ashoka ke putra Mahendra ke liye banwaye gaye tapasya-sthal (hermitage hill) ki chhoti pratima hai; Mahendra aage ja kar Ceylon yaani Sri Lanka me Bauddh dharm ke prasarak bane. Is murti ki puja mukhya roop se Dusadh tatha aise samuday karte hain jo purane samay me is kshetra me rahte the; woh phool, fal, doodh, mithai tatha resham ka dhaaga chadhaate hain. Is tarah aaj bhi ek prachin Bauddh parampara Patna ke lok-jeevan me zinda dikhti hai, chahe uske pujari yeh nahi jaante ki woh kis prachin parampara ka hissa hai. Exam point: Bhikhna Kunwar ki murti Ashoka ke putra Mahendra se judi mani jaati hai, jo aage Sri Lanka me Bauddh dharm ke prasarak bane; yah puja Dusadh tatha anya sthanik samuday karte hain tatha isme doodh, mithai, phool tatha resham ka dhaaga chadhaaya jaata hai.

qe: Popular tradition ascribes the naming of Pataliputra to Putraka, who named the city after whom?
qh: लोक-परंपरा के अनुसार पाटलिपुत्र का नाम 'पुत्रक' ने किसके नाम पर रखा था?
e: Pataliputra ke naam tatha uske basne ki kai lok-kathayein prachalit hain. Sabse lokpriya katha me Putraka naam ke raja ne apni patni Putali ke naam par is shahar ka naam Pataliputra rakha. Bauddh granthon me is shahar ki sthapna Ajatashatru ke samay batayi gayi hai; unke varnan me Bhagwan Buddha ne apni aakhri yatra (lagbhag 487 ee. poo.) ke dauran yahan ek raat vishram kiya tha, jab Ajatashatru Lichchhaviyon ke viruddh yahan kila bana rahe the. Baad me kila ke paas ek shahar basa, jo chauthi sadi ee. poo. me Maurya samrajya ki rajdhani ban gaya. Megasthenes ne is shahar ki sthapna ka shrey Herakles ko diya, isliye ek hi shahar ki utpatti ki kai kathayein milti hain. Exam point: lok-katha me Putraka ne apni patni Putali ke naam par shahar ka naam Pataliputra rakha; Bauddh vivaran me shahar ki shuruaat Ajatashatru ke kila se maani gayi tatha yeh chauthi sadi ee. poo. me Maurya rajdhani bana; Megasthenes ne ise Herakles se joda.

qe: The sandstone pillar at Bihar, 14 feet high and bearing two inscriptions of the Gupta dynasty, was moved from inside the old fort and placed upside down on a brick pedestal by which officer?
qh: बिहार का 14 फुट ऊँचा बलुआ-पत्थर का स्तंभ, जिस पर गुप्त वंश के दो शिलालेख हैं, पुराने किले के भीतर से हटाकर किस अधिकारी ने ईंट के चबूतरे पर उल्टा रखवाया?
e: Bihar ke avsheshon me sabse purana ek balua-patthar ka stambh hai, jo chaudah foot uncha hai tatha jispar Gupta vansh ke do shilalekh khude hain. Unme upar wala shilalekh Kumara Gupta ke samay (413-455 A.D.) ka hai tatha nichla shilalekh unke putra tatha uttaradhikari Skanda Gupta (455-480 A.D.) ka bataya jaata hai. Yah stambh pehle purane kila ke andar pada tha. Kila ke adhikari ki kaam-kaj ke karan ise broadley naam ke ek adhikari ne kila ke bahar court-house ke saamne eenton ke chabutare par rakha, woh bhi ulta tatha uspar ilake ke adhikariyon tatha pramukh nagrikon ki suchi khuda di. Aise stambh par abhilekh yaani shilalekh raja ke digvijay, dan tatha samay ki jankari dete hain, isliye yah itihas ke liye bahut mahatvapurna hai. Exam point: Bihar ke chaudah foot unche balua-patthar stambh par Kumara Gupta (413-455 A.D.) tatha Skanda Gupta (455-480 A.D.) ke do Gupta-kaal ke shilalekh hain; ise Broadley naam ke ek adhikari ne kila ke bahar chabutare par ulta rakhwaya tatha uspar ilake ke adhikariyon ki suchi khudwa di.

qe: The group of hillocks south of the Pipalpati road known as the panch panari marks the remains of how many Buddhist stupas, probably the five relic stupas built by Asoka?
qh: पीपलपाती मार्ग के दक्षिण में स्थित पंच पनारी नामक टीलों का समूह कितने बौद्ध स्तूपों के अवशेष हैं, जो संभवतः अशोक द्वारा बनाए गए पाँच धातु-स्तूप थे?
e: Pipalpati road ke dakshin ki or panch panari naam ke chhote-chhote teelon ka samooh hai. Yah panch Bauddh stupon ke avshesh hain, jinke baare me maana jaata hai ki yah woh paanch dhatu-stup the jo Ashok ne banwaye the. Stup ek gumbad ya dher jaisi Bauddh smarak imarat hoti hai, jisme Bhagwan Buddha ke avshesh ya unse judi smriti rakhi jaati thi. In teelon se aage bari tatha chhoti pahari hai, jine Colonel Waddell ne Upagupta ke tapasya-sthal wali pahadi se joda hai; Upagupta woh sant the jinhone Ashok ko Bauddh bhakti ki or laaya. Isi kshetra me ek teela Sadikpur Sanghram ke sthal par hai, jo ek purane stup ke avshesh dikhaata hai. Yah raasta Gulzarbagh railway station ke paas mail line ko cross karta hai tatha shahar ke pachhim darwaze par mukhya street se milta hai. Exam point: Panch panari ke chhote teele paanch Bauddh stupon ke avshesh hain, jine Ashok ke paanch dhatu-stup maana jaata hai tatha bari-chhoti pahari ko Upagupta ke tapasya-sthal se joda jaata hai.

qe: Colonel Waddell, making discoveries in 1905 of ancient beams, thought they were part of the wooden towers of Pataliputra mentioned by which Greek writer, at the field called Maharaj Khanda?
qh: 1905 में कर्नल वैडल ने महाराज खंड नामक मैदान में प्राचीन कड़ियों की खोज की तथा उन्हें पाटलिपुत्र के उन लकड़ी के बुर्जों का हिस्सा माना, जिनका वर्णन किस यूनानी लेखक ने किया था?
e: Pipalpati road par Kumrahar se thoda aage, road ke uttar, Maharaj Khanda hai, jiska arth hai samrat ka khet. Yahin Colonel Waddell ne 1905 me purani lakdi ki kadhiyon yaani beams ki khoj ki thi. Unka vichar tha ki ye beams Pataliputra ke un lakdi ke burjon tatha tower ka hissa hain, jinka varnan Greek lekhak Megasthenes ne kiya tha. Megasthenes Maurya daur me Pataliputra aaye Greek ambassador the; unhone apne vivran me shahar ki lakdi ki deewaron, khandaq tatha burjon ka zikr kiya tha. Iske vipreet road ke doosri or Agam Kuan hai, jo ek prachin kuan hai. Kumrahar me Dr. Spooner ko ek stambhon wala hall mila tha tatha Bulandibagh me shahar ke darwaze tatha rath-chakra ke avshesh nikle the; is tarah Patna ke dakshin-pashchimi kshetra Pataliputra ki puratatv-khoj ka mukhya kendra bane. Exam point: Colonel Waddell ne 1905 me Maharaj Khanda me mili purani lakdi ki kadhiyon ko Megasthenes dwara varnit Pataliputra ke lakdi ke burjon ka hissa maana; Maharaj Khanda ka arth samrat ka khet hai tatha yah Kumrahar ke paas hai.

qe: The low circular mound of large bricks at Bhagwanganj in the Dinapore subdivision has been identified with the stupa of which Brahman, described as the distributor of the relics of Buddha?
qh: दीनापुर अनुमंडल के भागवानगंज में बड़ी ईंटों से बना नीचा गोल टीला किस ब्राह्मण के स्तूप से पहचाना गया है, जिसे बुद्ध के अवशेष बाँटने वाला बताया गया?
e: Bharatpur tatha Dinapore subdivision ke dakshin-purb bhaag me Bhagwanganj gaon hai. Yahan ek teela hai jo Drona stup se pahchana gaya hai; Drona ek Brahman tha, jo Buddha ke mahaparinirvan ke baad unke avshesh yaani relics baantne ka kaam karta tha. Katha hai ki aath rajaon ne Buddha ke avshesh aapas me baant liye tatha avshesh naapne wale patra ko Drona apne desh le gaya; usne patra me bache avshesh kura kar unke upar ek stup banwaya. Baad me Ashok ne is stup ko khola, avshesh tatha patra nikal liye tatha wahin naya stup banwaya. Bhagwanganj ka teela tees-chalis foot vyas ka, karib bees foot uncha low circular mound hai, jo ekdum badi eenton tatha mitti se bana hai. Iske paas se Punpun nadi bahti hai; nadi ke kinare ek patthar tatha eenton ka lagbhag chalis foot ka mandir tatha aage ek aur teela bhi mila, jiski pooja aas-paas ke Bihta gaon ke log doodh chadha kar karte hain. Exam point: Bhagwanganj ka bada eenton wala teela Drona stup se pahchana gaya hai; Drona woh Brahman tha jisne Buddha ke avshesh baante tatha patra me bache avshesh par stup banwaya; aage Ashok ne ise khol kar avshesh nikale tatha naya stup banwaya.

qe: Jarasandha's seat or baithak at Giriak, occupying the eastern end of the ridge, is a solid cylindrical brick tower 28 feet in diameter and 21 feet in height; when surmounted by a dome it originally stood about how high, and when was it probably erected?
qh: गिरियक में जरासंध की बैठक, जो श्रेणी के पूर्वी सिरे पर स्थित है, 28 फुट व्यास तथा 21 फुट ऊँची ठोस बेलनाकार ईंट की मीनार है; गुंबद सहित यह मूल रूप से लगभग कितनी ऊँची थी तथा इसका निर्माण संभवतः कब हुआ?
e: Giriak Bihar subdivision ke sabse dakshin bhaag me Panchana nadi par sthit ek gaon hai, jo Bihar se terah meel dakshin me hai. Gaon ke pashchim me uthi hui oonchi pahadi hai, jise Fa Hian tatha Hiuen Tsiang dwara batayi gayi Indrasilaguha pahadi maana gaya hai. Panchana nadi ke tal se upar ek purana chunai hua yaani walled-up rasta aaj bhi kai jagah dekhne ko milta hai, jo khadi dhalan par upar jaata hai. Yah rasta us toote-hue stup tak le jaata hai, jise Jarasandha ki baithak kaha jaata hai. Yah imarat ek thos belanakar eenton ki minar hai, jiska vyas atthaais foot tatha unchai ikkees foot hai. Jab ispar gumbad hota tha, to yah pehle lagbhag pachpan foot unchi thi; iska nirman sambhavtah panch sau Isvi ke aas-paas hua. Sthaniya parampara is minar ko Jarasandha naam se jodti hai, jo Magadha ka prachin raja tha tatha kaha jaata hai ki woh ise bagiche ke ghar ki tarah istemal karta tha. Exam point: Giriak me sthit Jarasandha ki baithak ek thos belanakar eenton ki minar hai, jiska vyas 28 foot tatha unchai 21 foot hai; gumbad sahit yah pehle lagbhag 55 foot unchi thi tatha iska nirman sambhavtah 500 Isvi ke aas-paas hua.

qe: The great mound close to Ghosrawan, a village seven miles south-west of Bihar, is believed to be the ruin of a Buddhist temple called the Vajrasana Vihara; an inscription found there records the building of a temple by which officer, who was patronised by king Deva Pala and was appointed to govern Nalanda?
qh: बिहार से सात मील दक्षिण-पश्चिम स्थित घोसरावाँ के पास का बड़ा टीला वज्रासन विहार नामक बौद्ध मंदिर का खंडहर माना जाता है; वहाँ मिले शिलालेख में किस अधिकारी द्वारा मंदिर बनवाने का उल्लेख है, जिसे राजा देवपाल का संरक्षण प्राप्त था तथा जिसे नालंदा का शासन सौंपा गया था?
e: Ghosrawan Bihar subdivision me ek gaon hai, jo Bihar se saat meel dakshin-pashchim me sthit hai. Yah sthal pehle ek purane Bauddh sthan ka hissa tha, jiske avshesh kai teelon ke roop me milte hain. Inme se do teele vishesh roop se mahatvapurna hain - ek chhota lekin uncha teela, jispar Asa Devi ka mandir hai, tatha gaon ke paas ek bada teela, jise Bauddh mandir Vajrasana Vihara ka khandaar maana jaata hai. Yahan mila shilalekh batata hai ki Vira Deva naam ke ek adhikari ne ek mandir banwaya; unhe raja Deva Pala ka sanrakshan prapt tha tatha unhe Nalanda ka shasan saunpa gaya tha. Iske baad unhone ek Vihara banwaya, jisme Vajrasana yaani heere jaisa mazboot singhasan ya throne rakha gaya; vihara itna uncha tha ki aakash me udne wale usse Kailasa ya Mandara ki choti samajh lete the. Deva Pala ka zikr batata hai ki yah mandir nauvin sadi ke uttarardh me bana tha. Exam point: Ghosrawan ke bade teele ko Vajrasana Vihara naamak Bauddh mandir ka khandaar maana jaata hai; shilalekh ke mutabik Vira Deva ne, jine raja Deva Pala ka sanrakshan prapt tha tatha jine Nalanda ke shasan par niyukt kiya gaya tha, mandir tatha Vajrasana ke liye vihara banwaya, jo nauvin sadi ke uttarardh ki bat hai.

qe: In the Buddhist legend of Giriak, the monks of the monastery on the hill, being forbidden to take animal life, were without food when a flock of geese flew overhead; a goose fell dead and the monks built a great stupa called by what name?
qh: गिरियक की बौद्ध कथा के अनुसार पहाड़ी पर स्थित मठ के भिक्षु, प्राणी-हत्या के निषेध के कारण भूखे थे, तभी हंसों का झुंड उड़ता हुआ ऊपर से गुजरा; एक हंस मर कर गिर पड़ा और भिक्षुओं ने एक बड़ा स्तूप बनाया, जिसका नाम क्या था?
e: Giriak ki pahadi se juri ek bahut hi maarmik Bauddh katha milti hai. Kaha jaata hai ki pahadi par pehle ek Bauddh math yaani vihara tha. Bhikshuon ko apne dharm ke niyam ke mutabik prani-hatya karna varjit tha, isliye woh kuch dino se bhookhe the. Us samay hanson ka ek jhund upar se uda. Ek bhikshu ne pukara ki aaj bhaiyon ke paas khana nahi hai; hey bhagya-wale praniyo, ham par daya karo. Iske baad ek hans neeche gir kar mar gaya. Bhikshu ashcharya tatha daya se bhar gaye tatha unhone usi sthal par ek bada stup banwaya, jiske neeche us hans ko dafnaya gaya. Is smarak-stupa ko Hansa yaani hans ka stup tatha math ko Hansa Sangharama kaha gaya. Iske sthal wohi hai, jise Hiuen Tsiang ne hans ke stup tatha uske peeche vihar ke roop me bataya tha. Exam point: Giriak ki Bauddh katha ke mutabik bhookhe bhikshuon ne upar udte hanson me se ek ke mar kar girne par usi sthal par bada stup banwaya, jise Hansa yaani hans ka stup tatha math ko Hansa Sangharama kaha gaya; yah sthal Hiuen Tsiang dwara varnit hans-stup se milta hai.

qe: A quarter of a mile west of the great mound at Ghosrawan there is a large tank called Sahu Pokhar or Seth Pokhar; what does this name mean?
qh: घोसरावाँ के बड़े टीले से एक चौथाई मील पश्चिम में एक बड़ा तालाब है, जिसे साहू पोखर या सेठ पोखर कहा जाता है; इस नाम का अर्थ क्या है?
e: Ghosrawan ke puratatv-sambandhi sthalon me ek bada teela tatha uske paas kai anya avshesh shamil hain. Bade teele se pura chauthai meel pashchim ki or ek bada talab hai, jiska aakaar paanch sau foot chaukor hai. Ise Sahu Pokhar ya Seth Pokhar kaha jaata hai, jiska arth hai mahajan yaani banker ka talab. Seth tatha Sahu dono shabd us vyakti ke liye istemal hote the, jo vyapar tatha karobar me paisa lagata tha; purane samay me aise mahajanon ke naam par talab tatha mandir banwaye jaana aam baat thi. Gaon me ek khula kshetra bhi hai, jise Singh-bahani kaha jaata hai, jahan bade teele se mile murtiyan tatha shilp ek jagah rakhe gaye hain; Asa Devi ke chhote mandir me bhi shilpon ka ek aur sangrah hai tatha uske dakshin-purb me ek chhote mandir me kuch aur murtiyan rakhi gayi hain. Exam point: Ghosrawan ke bade teele se chauthai meel pashchim me sthit paanch sau foot chaukor talab ko Sahu Pokhar ya Seth Pokhar kaha jaata hai, jiska arth mahajan yaani banker ka talab hai; gaon me Singh-bahani naam ka khula kshetra tatha chhote mandiron me shilpon ke sangrah bhi hain.

qe: The hill rising immediately to the west of Giriak has been identified as the Indrasilaguha mountain of the Chinese pilgrims, sacred to the Buddhists as containing the cave in which Buddha answered how many questions of Indra, the lord of the Devas?
qh: गिरियक के ठीक पश्चिम में उठने वाली पहाड़ी को चीनी यात्रियों द्वारा वर्णित इंद्रशिलागुहा पर्वत माना गया है, जो बौद्धों के लिए पवित्र है क्योंकि उसमें वह गुफा है जहाँ बुद्ध ने देवों के स्वामी इंद्र के कितने प्रश्नों का उत्तर दिया था?
e: Giriak gaon Bihar subdivision ke sabse dakshin bhaag me Panchana nadi par sthit hai tatha Bihar se terah meel dakshin me hai; wahan pahunchne ke liye ek metalled road hai. Gaon ke pashchim me turant uthne wali chattan wali pahadi ko Chinese yatriyon, Fa Hian tatha Hiuen Tsiang, dwara batayi gayi Indrasilaguha pahadi maana gaya hai. Yah pahadi Bauddh logon ke liye vishesh roop se pavitra hai, kyunki yahan woh gufa hai, jiske baare me kaha jaata hai ki isme Bhagwan Buddha ne Indra, jo devon ka swami tha, ke bayalis prashnon ka uttar diya tha. Gaon ke saamne, Panchana nadi ke pashchim kinare par, Rajgir pahadiyon ki uttari shrreni par ek purane stup ke avshesh bhi mile hain tatha uske thoda pashchim me unchi jagah par ek lamba chabutara hai, jispar kai imaraton ke khandaar hain; inme pramukh imarat ek Bauddh math ki maloom hoti hai. Exam point: Giriak ke pashchim ki pahadi ko Fa Hian tatha Hiuen Tsiang dwara varnit Indrasilaguha parvat maana gaya hai, jahan Buddha ne devon ke swami Indra ke bayalis prashnon ka uttar diya tha; gaon ke paas purane stup tatha Bauddh math ke avshesh bhi mile hain.

qe: Nalanda, the site of the most famous of the monasteries of Magadha, lies south of the modern village of Bargaon; with which ancient Vihara-gram has this place been identified?
qh: मगध के सबसे प्रसिद्ध मठ का स्थल नालंदा आधुनिक गाँव बरगाँव के दक्षिण में स्थित है; यह स्थल किस प्राचीन नाम से पहचाना गया है?
e: Nalanda Bihar ke sabse prasiddh Bauddh mazhab ke math ka sthal hai, jo Nalanda jile me Bargaon gaon ke dakshin me sthit hai. Yah sthal B.B. Light Railway ke Nalanda station se teen meel ki doori par hai tatha wahan se ek rasta jata hai. Atharahvin sadi ke aakhir tatha unnisvin sadi ke shuru me yahan khudai karne wale puraatatvik vidwanon ne is sthal ko purane Vihara-gram se pahchana, jiske kinare par bade Nalanda math ka failav tha. Gaon ke aas-paas ke talabon ke kinare par yah math apne poore vaibhav ke saath khada tha. Kaha jaata hai ki jab Rajagriha ki gufaayein tatha mandir khandaar hone lage tatha Bauddh log apne guru ke pahadi-nivas chhodne lage, tab Bargaon ke talabon ke kinare Nalanda ka math apni poori shobha ke saath uth kar khada hua. Exam point: Bargaon gaon ke dakshin me sthit Nalanda ko purane Vihara-gram se pahchana gaya, jiske kinare bade Nalanda mahavihar ka failav tha; yah sthal B.B. Light Railway ke Nalanda station se teen meel door hai tatha yahan unnisvin sadi ke puraatatvik vidwanon ne khudai ki thi.

qe: At the great Nalanda monastery there was a severe kind of entrance examination; in the account, the students who came from outside had to show their ability by hard discussion, and those who failed compared with those who succeeded were as what?
qh: महान नालंदा मठ में प्रवेश की एक कठोर परीक्षा होती थी; वर्णन के अनुसार बाहर से आने वाले विद्यार्थियों को कठिन शास्त्रार्थ से अपनी योग्यता दिखानी पड़ती थी, तथा असफल होने वालों की संख्या सफल होने वालों की तुलना में क्या थी?
e: Nalanda ka math apne samay me Bauddh shiksha ka sabse bada kendra tha; ise Bauddh Bharat ka Oxford bhi kaha jaata hai. Yahan talabon ke kinare unche pagode, shastrarth ke hall tatha padhane ke school bane hue the; har talab ke kinare mandir tatha stup banaye gaye the tatha har minar ke aadhaar ke charon or imaratein khadi thin. Saatvin sadi ke Chinese yatri Hiuen Tsiang ke mutabik yahan bahut se mandir, pagode tatha sthal the tatha das hazaar bhikshu rehte the, jo apna poora jeevan gyaan ki khoj me bitate the. Yahan pravesh ki ek bahut kathor pariksha hoti thi. Dwar-pal yaani gatekeeper mushkil prashn poochta tha; bahut log jawab na de paate tatha laut jaate the. Kaha gaya hai ki purani tatha nayi dono tarah ki kitabein gehraai se padhne ke baad hi pravesh milta tha; bahar se aane wale vidyarthiyon ko kathin shastrarth se apni yogyata dikhani padti thi tatha asafal hone wale safal hone walon ki tulna me saat ya aath banam das ke anupat me the. Exam point: Nalanda mahavihar me pravesh ke liye kathor pariksha hoti thi, jisme dwar-pal mushkil prashn poochta tha; kaha gaya hai ki asafal hone wale vidyarthi safal hone walon ki tulna me saat ya aath banam das ke anupat me the tatha yahan Hiuen Tsiang ke samay das hazaar bhikshu rehte the.

qe: On the south of the Nalanda monastery there was a tank in which the dragon or Naga Nalanda used to dwell; with which existing small tank was it identified?
qh: नालंदा मठ के दक्षिण में वह तालाब था, जिसमें नाग नालंदा रहता था; उसे किस वर्तमान छोटे तालाब से पहचाना गया?
e: Nalanda mahavihar ke avsheshon me eenton ke bade khandaar milte hain, jo uttar se dakshin ki or faile hue hain. Bade stupon ke 100 gaz purb me viharaon ka ek jaal sa faila hua hai, jinme math ke aangan shayad aaj ki chaukor kheton ke roop me pehchane ja sakte hain; yah kshetra 1,600 by 400 foot me faila hua hai. Nalanda ke dakshin me, jaisa bataya jaata hai, woh talab tha, jisme Naga Nalanda yaani nagraj rehta tha. Nag ek myth-katha ka saanp-jaisa prani hota hai, jise jal-sthalon ka rakhwala maana jaata tha. Is talab ki pehchan maujooda chhote talab Kargidya Pokhar se ki gayi, jo sthal ke hisab se us nag-raj ke talab se milta hai. Iske alawa yahan khudai me mili alag-alag murtiyan Nalanda ki purani shaan ki gawahi deti hain tatha kaha jaata hai ki Bharat ke sabse achhe shilp is sthal par mile tatha unme se bada hissa aage Calcutta ke museum pahuncha. Exam point: Nalanda ke dakshin wale talab, jisme Naga Nalanda rehta tha, ko Kargidya Pokhar naam ke maujooda chhote talab se pehchana gaya; Nalanda ke viharaon ka jaal bade stupon se 100 gaz purb me 1,600 by 400 foot ke kshetra me faila hua hai.

qe: Systematic exploration of the Nalanda site began in 1916 and was continued in later years by Mr. J. A. Page of the Archaeological Survey; who began this systematic exploration in 1916?
qh: नालंदा स्थल की क्रमबद्ध खुदाई 1916 में शुरू हुई तथा आगे के वर्षों में इसे पुरातत्व सर्वेक्षण के श्री जे. ए. पेज ने जारी रखा; 1916 में यह क्रमबद्ध अन्वेषण किसने शुरू किया?
e: Nalanda sthal par puraatatvik kaam kai daur me hua. Sabse pehle 1870 ke dashak me yahan khudai karne wale adhikari ne is sthal ko Vihara-gram se joda tatha apni reporton me Nalanda ki shaan ka varnan kiya. Us daur ki khudai se pata chala ki yahan bade puraatatvik avshesh hain. Aage chal kar 1916 me Dr. Spooner ne is sthal ki krambaddh yaani systematic exploration shuru ki, jise baad ke saalon me Archaeological Survey ke Mr. J. A. Page ne jaari rakha. In khudaiyon me sabse mahatvapurna khojen do math, ek stup tatha ek mandir ko khol kar saamne laana raha. Is tarah Nalanda ek aise sthal ke roop me ubhara, jahan varshon tak chalne wale vyavasthit kaam se yah saabit hua ki yahan ek bada vishwavidyalaya jaisa mahavihar tha, jahan shiksha, charcha tatha puja - teeno ka kendra ek jagah tha. Exam point: Nalanda sthal par krambaddh yaani systematic exploration 1916 me Dr. Spooner ne shuru ki, jise aage Archaeological Survey ke Mr. J. A. Page ne jaari rakha; in khudaiyon se do math, ek stup tatha ek mandir saamne aaye.

qe: The monastery at Nalanda in which exploration was most completely carried out measures 205 feet by 168 feet; its entrance lay through a great portico resting on pillars, the portico measuring what?
qh: नालंदा का वह मठ, जहाँ अन्वेषण सबसे पूर्ण रूप से हुआ, 205 फुट गुणा 168 फुट का है; उसका प्रवेश स्तंभों पर टिके एक बड़े पोर्टिको से होकर जाता था, जिसका माप क्या था?
e: Nalanda ki khudaiyon me sabse mahatvapurna kaam Site No. 1 naam wale math par hua, jiska aakaar do sau paanch foot guna ek sau arsath foot hai tatha jiski deewar chhah foot aadhe inch moti thi. Khudai ke dauran yahan aath alag-alag strata yaani partein pehchani gayi, jo yah dikhati hain ki jab-jab yah math aag se jal jaata ya kamzor bananaawat se gir jaata tha, tab-tab uske khandaaron par nayi imaratein banai jaati thin. Sabse neeche wali taha, jo yahan ki sabse purani imarat ki maani jaati hai, chhathe ya saatven sadi Isvi ki lagti hai. Is math ka pravesh ek bade portico se hota tha, jiska aakaar pacchas foot guna chaubees foot tha tatha jo stambhon par tika hua tha; in stambhon ke tal aaj bhi apni jagah maujood hain. Is portico ke saamne, bade aangan ke us paar, ek chhota mandir tha, jisme Buddha ki ek bahut badi murti thi, jiske tukde mil chuke hain. Exam point: Nalanda ke Site No. 1 wale math ka aakaar 205 foot guna 168 foot hai tatha uski deewar karib chhah foot moti thi; yahan aath strata pehchane gaye tatha pravesh ka bada portico pacchas foot guna chaubees foot ka tha, jo stambhon par tika tha.

qe: Rajgir, the terminus of the light railway from Bakhtiyarpur, was originally the capital of which prehistoric king of Magadha and Chedi, who is mentioned in the Mahabharata as taking a prominent part in the great war?
qh: बख्तियारपुर से आने वाली लाइट रेलवे का अंतिम स्टेशन राजगीर मूल रूप से मगध तथा चेदि के किस प्रागैतिहासिक राजा की राजधानी था, जिसका उल्लेख महाभारत में महायुद्ध में प्रमुख भाग लेने वाले के रूप में है?
e: Rajgir Bihar subdivision me sthit ek gaon hai, jo Bihar se arh meel dakshin-pashchim me hai tatha vahan se aane wali light railway ka antim sthal yaani terminus hai; Bihar se yahan ek bina pucca sadak aati hai, jo har jagah pulon se bani hai tatha barish ke baad chhod kar aam taur par aasani se chalne yogya hai. Gaon me ek dispensary tatha ek achha inspection bungalow hai; 1921 me yahan ki aabaadi do hazaar chhah sau tiranaave thi. Rajgir Patna jile ke sabse rochak sthalon me se ek hai. Yah mool roop se Jarasandha ki rajdhani thi, jo Magadha tatha Chedi desh ka praitinihit karne wala ek pranik raja tha; Chedi desh ko aaj Bundelkhand kaha jaata hai. Mahabharat me Jarasandha ka zikr mahayuddh me pramukh bhoomika nibhane wale ke roop me milta hai tatha uski smriti aaj bhi sthanik lok-kathaon me zinda hai; uske kila ki mazboot deewarein aas-paas ki pahadiyon par chadhti hui aaj bhi dekhi ja sakti hain.
