Exam point: Rajgir Bihar se 18.5 meel dakshin-pashchim me Bakhtiyarpur wali light railway ka terminus hai, jahan 1921 me 2,693 log rehte the; yah mool roop se Jarasandha ki rajdhani thi, jo Magadha tatha Chedi (Bundelkhand) ka pranik raja tha tatha jiska Mahabharat me mahayuddh me bada hissa bataya gaya hai.

qe: In historic times Rajgir became the capital of which ruler, who around 528-500 B.C. made his capital in the valley between the hills which formed Jarasandha's fortress?
qh: ऐतिहासिक काल में राजगीर किस शासक की राजधानी बना, जिसने लगभग 528-500 ईसा पूर्व उस घाटी में अपनी राजधानी बनाई जो जरासंध के किले की पहाड़ियों के बीच थी?
e: Rajgir pehle Jarasandha ki rajdhani thi tatha uske kila ki deewarein aas-paas ki pahadiyon par chadhti hui bani thin. Aitihasik kal me Bimbisara ne, jo lagbhag paanch sau atthaais se paanch sau Isvi purv tak rajya karta tha, apni rajdhani us ghati me banai, jo Jarasandha ke kila tatha unke pahadi kshetra ke beech me thi. Yah ghati do pahadi shreniyon ke beech padti hai tatha charon or se pahadiyon tatha unki deewaron se ghire hone ke karan suraksha ke liye bahut hi upyukt thi. Aise sthal ko dekh kar pata chalta hai ki us samay rajdhani chunne me suraksha, paani tatha vyapar ke raston ka kitna khayal rakha jaata tha. Rajgir aage chal kar Bauddh tatha Jain dono paramparaon ka mahatvapurna kendra bana tatha yahan ke pahadon me Bauddh dharm ke purane smarak bhi bane, isliye yah sthal itihas tatha dharm - dono drishti se mahatvapurna hai. Exam point: Aitihasik kal me Rajgir Bimbisara ki rajdhani bana, jisne lagbhag 528-500 Isvi purv me Jarasandha ke kila ki pahadiyon ke beech wali ghati me apni rajdhani banai; suraksha, paani tatha vyapar ke raston ka khayal rakhte hue yah sthal chuna gaya tatha aage yah Bauddh tatha Jain paramparaon ka bhi kendra bana.

qe: A copper-plate inscription found at the entrance to the Nalanda monastery records the grant of five villages in the Gaya and Rajagriha districts for the upkeep of the monastery, made at the request of the king of which country?
qh: नालंदा मठ के प्रवेश-द्वार पर मिला ताम्रपत्र शिलालेख गया तथा राजगृह जिलों के पाँच गाँवों का दान दर्ज करता hai, जो किस देश के राजा के अनुरोध पर किया गया था?
e: Nalanda ke math ke pravesh-dwar par ek tamrapatr yaani taambe ki plate par khuda hua shilalekh mila. Tamrapatr woh patli taambe ki plate hoti hai, jispar raja ya sasan ke aadesh khod kar likhe jaate the tatha jo hamesha ke liye suchna sambhal kar rakhti thi. Yah shilalekh Sri Devapaladeva ka hai, jo Pala vansh ke teesre shasak the; ispar khudi tareekh 891 Isvi se milti hai. Shilalekh me darj hai ki Gaya tatha Rajagriha ke kshetron me paanch gaon Nalanda math ke kharch tatha wahan aane wale bhikshuon ki suvidhaon ke liye daan me diye gaye. Yah daan Sumatra ke raja Sri Balaputra Deva ke anurodh par kiya gaya, sambhavtah us desh me barabar daan milne ke badle me. Isse pata chalta hai ki Nalanda ka math keval ek sthaniya sanstha nahi tha, balki doosre deshon ke rajaon tatha shasakon se juda hua antarrashtriya shiksha-kendra tha, jahan door-door se log padhne aate the. Exam point: Nalanda ke pravesh par mila tamrapatr Pala vansh ke teesre shasak Sri Devapaladeva ka hai, jispar 891 Isvi ki tareekh hai; isme Gaya tatha Rajagriha ke paanch gaon math ke kharch ke liye daan diye jaane ka zikr hai, jo Sumatra ke raja Sri Balaputra Deva ke anurodh par hua.

qe: In one of the Nalanda monasteries two parallel rows of hearths, seven in number and connected by a common duct, were found; the excavator thought the building may have been used as what?
qh: नालंदा के एक मठ में सात चूल्हों की दो समानांतर कतारें मिलीं, जो एक साझा नाली से जुड़ी थीं; खुदाई करने वाले ने माना कि यह भवन किस रूप में प्रयोग होता होगा?
e: Nalanda ki khudai me ek aisa math bhi mila, jiske uttar se ek stambhon wale portico tatha vestibule ke raste pravesh kiya jaata tha; portico ke stambhon ke aadhaar aaj bhi bache hue hain. Is math ka plan ek aayat tha, jisme har or bhikshuon ke kamre the tatha dakshin kinare ke beech me shayad ek chhota mandir tha; charon or stambhon wala veranda tatha beech me do samanantar kataron me saat chulhe the, jo ek saath milakar bani nali yaani duct se jude the, jiski unchai lagbhag do foot thi. Khudai karne wale pandit ka vichar tha ki in chulhon ka istemal dawa taiyar karne me hota hoga, isliye yah imarat ek chikitsa-shikshalay ya Bhishak-sala ho sakti hai; Bhishak ka arth hai vaidya ya chikitsak. Is math ke Purva-kone me ek aath-kon wala kuan tha, jisme se khudai ke samay kai mitti ke bartan nikle; purb ke do kamron me sadi hui chawal tatha jau ke dher mile, jo bhandar-grihon ke roop me istemal hote the; tatha uttar ke kamron me Tara, Avalokitesvara, Maitreya tatha Buddha ki taambe tatha patthar ki kai murtiyan mili, jo shayad alag-alag bhikshuon ke ishta-devtaon ka chinh thi. Exam point: Nalanda ke ek math me saat chulhon ki do samanantar katarein mili, jo ek saath do foot unchi nali se judi thin; vaidya sambandhi kaam ke karan khudai karne wale ne ise chikitsa-shikshalay ya Bhishak-sala maana, tatha isi math me mitti ke bartan wala kuan, anaaj ke bhandar tatha Tara, Avalokitesvara, Maitreya aur Buddha ki murtiyan bhi mili.

qe: The high stupa at the south end of the range of mounds at Nalanda, known as vihara A, is described as being how high, with the stupa court showing three distinct levels?
qh: नालंदा के टीलों की कतार के दक्षिणी सिरे पर स्थित ऊँचा स्तूप, जिसे विहार A कहा जाता है, कितना ऊँचा बताया गया है, जबकि स्तूप-प्रांगण में तीन अलग-अलग स्तर दिखाई देते हैं?
e: Nalanda ke mathon ke saath-saath chalti teelon ki kataar ke dakshin sire par ek uncha stup hai, jise vihara A kaha jaata hai. Yah lagbhag tiraasi foot uncha hai tatha iske upari bhaag ki motai karib sattar foot hai. Is stup ko us sthal se joda jaata hai, jahan Bhagwan Buddha ne teen mahine tak ruk kar devon ko dharm ka updesh diya tha. Iski khudai me yah baat saamne aayi ki iske teen alag-alag eenton ke aavaran yaani integuments mile, jisme har naya aavaran poore purane stup ko dhak kar bana tha; is tarah nirman-kar tatha pujari purani imarat ke girne ka intezaar nahi karte the, balki nayi chunai chadha kar stup ko bada karte jaate the. Is stup ke charon kono par chaar minar bhi the. Stup ke aangan me chhote-chhote kai stup the, jo ek doosre ke upar kabhi do ya teen baar bane the; aaj yahan teen alag-alag stara yaani level dekhe ja sakte hain. Is tarah Nalanda ka stup-kshetra lagatar badhti hui shraddha tatha nirman-kala ka anokha udaharan hai. Exam point: Nalanda ke dakshin sire wala stup, jise vihara A kaha jaata hai, lagbhag 83 foot uncha hai tatha upari bhaag me karib 70 foot mota hai; ise us sthal se joda jaata hai, jahan Buddha ne teen mahine devon ko dharm ka updesh diya, tatha iske teen eenton ke aavran tatha charon kono par minar mile.

qe: At Nalanda, the high mound at the northern extremity of the range of stupa mounds has been identified with which temple, which the Chinese pilgrim described as closely resembling the Temple of Buddh Gaya?
qh: नालंदा में स्तूप-टीलों की कतार के उत्तरी सिरे पर स्थित ऊँचे टीले को किस मंदिर से पहचाना गया है, जो चीनी यात्री के वर्णन के अनुसार बोधगया के मंदिर जैसा था?
e: Nalanda ke teelon ki kataar ke uttari sire par sthit unche teele ko Baladitya ke mandir se pahchana gaya hai. Kaha jaata hai ki yah mandir dekhne me Bodh Gaya ke mandir se bahut milta tha; Bodh Gaya ka mandir unka mukhya smarak agar hai, jahan Bhagwan Buddha ko bodhi yaani gyaan ki prapti hui thi. Aapko yah bhi dhyan mein rakhna chahiye ki Bodh Gaya ka mandir apne aaj ke roop me lagbhag ek sau sattar foot uncha hai. Baladitya ke mandir ke dakshin kinare par ek aavran-deewar aaj bhi dekhi ja sakti hai, jo purani imarat ke charon or nayi chunai chadha kar use bada karne ki purani rieti ka ek aur udaharan hai. Iske dakshin tatha pashchim kinare par thoda neeche ek plinth bhi mila, jispar do se zyada katarein painel ki thin, jo pehle chhote stambhon tatha pattiyon ki naqashi se saji hui thin. Aise avshesh Nalanda ke nirman-kram tatha uski lagatar marammat tatha vistar ki gawahi dete hain. Exam point: Nalanda me teelon ke uttari sire wale unche teele ko Baladitya ke mandir se pehchana gaya, jo Bodh Gaya ke mandir jaisa bataya gaya; Bodh Gaya ka mandir apne aaj ke roop me lagbhag 170 foot uncha hai tatha Baladitya ke mandir ke dakshin kinare par purana aavran-deewar aaj bhi dekhi ja sakti hai.

qe: The ruined stone temple at Nalanda (Site No. 2), square in plan and uncovered in 1916, has for its feature of special interest a dado of how many sculptured panels over the exterior base moulding?
qh: नालंदा का खंडहर पत्थर का मंदिर (स्थल संख्या 2), जो वर्गाकार योजना का है तथा 1916 में खुला, अपनी विशेष रुचि की विशेषता के रूप में बाहरी आधार-सज्जा पर कितने मूर्ति-पैनलों का दादो रखता है?
e: Nalanda me 1916 ki khudai me ek toote hue patthar ke mandir ke charon kinare saamne aaye, jise Site No. 2 kaha jaata hai. Yah mandir plan me chaukor tha tatha iska pravesh purb ki or ek chhoti seedhi se hota tha; har deewar ke beech ka hissa thoda bahar ki or nikla hua tha. Iski sabse rochak visheshata iske bahari aadhaar ki sajaawat ke upar bane 211 moorti-painel ka dado hai, jinme tarah-tarah ki moortiyan tatha kalakriti dikhti hain; dado ka arth hai deewar ke neeche ki or bani hui sajawat ki patti. Yah imarat apne se pehle ki eenton wali imarat ke upar banai gayi thi tatha aise lagta hai ki iske painel purani imarat se nikale gaye the; in painelon ko chhathi ya saatvin sadi Isvi ka bataya gaya hai. Is tarah Nalanda me sirf math tatha stup hi nahi, balki sundar mandir bhi the, jinki sajaawat dekh kar us daur ki kalakari ka andaza hota hai tatha yah dikhata hai ki purane maal ko naye sire se laga kar nayi imarat banane ki rieti kaise chalti thi. Exam point: Nalanda ke Site No. 2 wale vargakar patthar ke mandir me bahari aadhaar ki sajaawat ke upar 211 moorti-painel ka dado hai, jo iski sabse rochak visheshata hai; yah imarat purani eenton wali imarat ke upar bani thi tatha painel chhathi-saatvin sadi ke bataye jaate hain.

qe: Near Baladitya's Temple at Nalanda statues were set up with the names of the figures inscribed on them; the two flying figures with garlands overhead are named as which two principal disciples of Buddha?
qh: नालंदा में बालादित्य के मंदिर के पास मूर्तियाँ स्थापित की गईं, जिन पर आकृतियों के नाम खुदे थे; ऊपर मालाएँ लिए उड़ती हुई दो आकृतियाँ बुद्ध के किन दो प्रमुख शिष्यों के नाम से अंकित हैं?
e: Nalanda ke Baladitya mandir ke paas kai Bauddh murtiyan mili tatha inhe sthapit kiya gaya. Inme Buddha ki ek moti murti bhi hai, jise Batuk Bhadrava kaha jaata hai tatha jo pehle mandir ke andar hi sthapit thi. Ek anya murti Buddha ko bhumisparsa mudra me dikhati hai; bhumisparsa mudra woh baithne ki mudra hai, jisme Buddha apni ek ungli se zameen ko chhoote hue dikhte hain tatha yah bodhi prapti ke kshan ko darshati hai. Is murti ke dono or khadi hui do aakritiyan hain, jinhe Arya Vasumitra tatha Arya Maitreya kaha jaata hai; inke upar do udti hui aakritiyan hain, jo apne haathon me malaayein yaani garlands liye hue hain tatha jine Arya Sariputra tatha Arya Maudgalyana kaha gaya hai, jo Buddha ke do pramukh shishya the. Kaha jaata hai ki ye Arhat the, isliye unme hawa me udne ki shakti thi. In sabhi aakritiyon ke naam usi murti par khude hue milte hain, jisse pata chalta hai ki Bauddh kalakaron ne sirf gyaan nahi, balki pavitra aakritiyon ke naam bhi shraddha ke saath darj kiye. Exam point: Nalanda me bhumisparsa mudra wali Buddha murti ke dono or Arya Vasumitra tatha Arya Maitreya khadi aakritiyan hain tatha upar malaayein liye udti hui aakritiyan Arya Sariputra tatha Arya Maudgalyana hain, jo Buddha ke do pramukh shishya tatha Arhat the; in sabhi naam usi murti par khude hue hain.

qe: A grand old straight embankment near Rajgir, attributed to Jarasandha and hence called the Asuren, is about how wide?
qh: राजगीर के पास जरासंध से जुड़ा और इसी कारण असुरेन कहा जाने वाला पुराना सीधा बाँध लगभग कितना चौड़ा है?
e: Rajgir ke paas ek bahut purana aur seedha bandh-numa avshesh hai, jise log Jarasandha ke naam se jodte hain, isliye uski sthaniya naam Asuren pad gaya. Yah poori tarah seedhi line me chal kar aage badhta hai aur dono kinaron se dheere-dheere beech ki taraf utha hua hai; beech ka hissa maidan se lagbhag 12 feet ooncha tha. Iski chaudai lagbhag 150 feet bayai gayi hai. Itni chaudi aur seedhi bani hui vedi dekh kar hi log ise kisi raja ke banwaye reservoir yaani paani jama karne ke talab ke roop me yaad karte hain, kyunki aisa seedha aur chaudi rachna banana bade shram aur vishisht yojana ka kaam hota hai. Iske kinare-kinare aaj bhi kheti hoti hai. Exam point: Jarasandha se jude Asuren naam ke purane seedhe bandh ki chaudai lagbhag 150 feet thi, aur uska beech ka hissa maidan se takriban 12 feet ooncha tha.

qe: The outer fort of old Rajagriha, regarded as the abode of Jarasandha, extended about how far each way?
qh: पुराने राजगृह का बाहरी किला, जिसे जरासंध का निवास माना जाता है, हर ओर लगभग कितना फैला हुआ था?
e: Purane Rajagriha me do purane qile the. Bahari qila, jise Jarasandha ke niwas-sthal ke roop me yaad kiya jata hai, ek vishal aur aniyamit aakar ka bhaag tha, jo har taraf lagbhag 1,200 gaj tak faila hua tha. Uske aas-paas khoda gaya ghera, yaani khai, lagbhag 100 feet se zyada chauda tha. Us qile ki praachir yaani rampart unhi khet-gadhai se nikli mitti se bani thi, jisme na eentein thi na patthar; kai jagah rampart me gap the, jinhe darwaza kaha ja sakta hai, par unki sthiti aniyamit thi. Qile ke andar aur bahar ki zameen me kheti hoti thi aur kuchh talab bhi mile, jinke kinaron par mailon ke dher bane hue the. Exam point: Bahari purana Rajagriha qila har taraf lagbhag 1,200 gaj tak faila hua tha, aur uske aas-paas khodi gayi khai 100 feet se zyada chaudi thi.

qe: In the tradition of the Sravakas of Rajgir, the fort was built by which king, whose residence there gave the place the name Rajagriha?
qh: राजगीर के श्रावकों की परंपरा में किला किस राजा ने बनवाया था, जिसके वहाँ निवास के कारण उस स्थान का नाम राजगृह पड़ा?
e: Rajgir me rehne wale Sravak yaani Jain dharm ke anuyayi logon ki ek prakhyat manyata thi ki us qile ka nirman Raja Senak ya Srenik ne karwaya tha, aur apne niwas ke kaaran us jagah ka naam Rajagriho yaani raja ka ghar pad gaya. Unhi ki parampara ke mutabik yahi raja Baragaon bhi banwaya tha aur woh Mahavira ka samkaleen bataya jata tha. Sravaka shabd Jain dharm ke anuyayi ke liye prayog hota hai, jo tapasya aur ahimsa par jor dete hain. Unki manyata me Senak Jarasandha ke bahut baad hua tha, aur Jarasandha ke baare me unka vishwas tha ki woh Ayodhya me rahta tha. Is prakar sthaniya Jain parampara ne Rajagriha ke aarambhik raja ka naam Senak ya Srenik bataya, jise itihas me Bimbisara ke naam se bhi jana jata hai. Exam point: Rajgir ke Sravakon ki parampara me qile ka nirman Raja Senak ya Srenik ne karwaya tha, jiske niwas ke kaaran us jagah ka naam Rajagriho pada.

qe: Though locally believed to be a reservoir that carried rain water towards Rajagriha, what was the Asuren near Rajgir actually found to be?
qh: स्थानीय रूप से इसे बारिश का पानी राजगृह की ओर पहुँचाने वाला जलाशय माना जाता है, पर असुरेन वास्तव में क्या पाया गया?
oe: A boundary wall of the old city
An irrigation canal drawn from the Panchana river
A flood embankment for the fields of the plain
A raised road forming a noble approach to the prince residence
oh: पंचाना नदी से निकाली गई सिंचाई-नहर
मैदान के खेतों के लिए बाढ़-रोधक बाँध
राजकुमार के निवास तक जाने वाला एक उन्नत और श्रेष्ठ मार्ग
e: Is seedhe aur chaudi vedi ke baare me logon ka vishwas tha ki yah ek reservoir yaani paani jama karne wali rachna thi, jo barish ka paani ikattha karke Rajagriha tak pahunchati thi aur phir us paani ko pahad ki choti par bandhe hue phoolon ke bagh tak uthaya jata tha. Lekin dhyan se dekhein to yah vedi sirf neeche ke maidan me kuchh hi mile, yaani lagbhag char mile, chalti hai aur Rajagriha pahunchne se lagbhag ek mile pehle hi khatam ho jati hai, jahan zameen uthni shuru hoti hai. Isi kaaran se saaf hota hai ki isse paani Rajagriha tak kabhi pahunchaya hi nahi ja sakta tha. Isliye yah vastutah raja ke niwas tak pahunchne ka ek uttam aur manohar marg tha, jise kai barishon ne gira kar chaudi kar diya. Exam point: Log ise jalashay maante the, par yah vastutah raja ke niwas tak jane wala ek shreshth unnath marg tha, kyunki yah pahad shuru hone se pehle hi khatam ho jata hai.

qe: The rampart of the outer fort at old Rajagriha was made entirely of what material?
qh: पुराने राजगृह के बाहरी किले की परकोटा-दीवार पूरी तरह किस पदार्थ की बनी थी?
oe: Baked bricks joined with lime mortar
Earth thrown out of the ditch, with no bricks or stones
Rough stone blocks from the neighbouring hills
A mixture of brick and timber
oh: चूने के गारे से जुड़ी पकी ईंटें
खाई से निकाली गई मिट्टी, जिसमें न ईंट थी न पत्थर
पास की पहाड़ियों के कच्चे पत्थर
e: Purane Rajagriha ke bahari qile ki praachir yaani rampart ke baare me ek badi baat yah hai ki woh poori tarah wahi mitti thi, jo uske aas-paas khodi gayi khai se nikali thi. Us mitti ke dher me na ek bhi eent lagi thi aur na koi patthar. Iska matlab hai ki yah qila-bandhi kachchi mitti ki vedi ke roop me thi, jise barish aur samay ke saath girne aur phailne ka mauka mila. Aaj us rampart ko zameen se lagbhag barabar ki oonchai wale mitti ke dher ke roop me dekh sakte hain. Aise purane mitti ke qile Bihar me jagah-jagah mile hain, jaise Behar ke bare qile ka gadha. Yahi baat batati hai ki aarambhik daur me qila banane ke liye zyada tar mitti aur maidan ka upyog hota tha, na ki pakki eenton ka. Exam point: Bahari Rajagriha qile ki praachir poori tarah khai se nikli mitti ki bani thi; usme na eentein thi na patthar.

qe: The Sravaka tradition credits the builder of the fort of Rajagriha with also building which place, and makes him a contemporary of Mahavira?
qh: श्रावक परंपरा राजगृह के किले के निर्माता को किस स्थान का भी बनवाने वाला मानती है और उसे महावीर का समकालीन बताती है?
e: Sravak yaani Jain parampara ke logon ki manyata thi ki Rajagriha qile ka nirmata wahi raja tha, jisne Baragaon bhi banwaya tha. Baragaon aaj Nalanda ke khandaharon ke paas ka wahi gaon hai, jiske dakshin me Nalanda ki biharon aur viharon ke dher hain. Unki parampara me yah raja Mahavira ka samkaleen tha, yaani Jain dharm ke chaubisve tirthankar ke samay me hua tha, aur unka deh-tyag Pawapuri me hua tha, jo Bihar ka ek khaas Jain sthal hai. Is prakar Rajgir aur Baragaon dono ko ek hi raja se jodne wali yah parampara dikhati hai ki us samay Rajagriha Magadha ka rajkiya kendra tha aur Nalanda kshetra uska dharmik aur shaikshik kendra ban raha tha. Exam point: Rajagriha qile ke nirmata ko Sravak parampara Mahavira ka samkaleen batati hai aur wahi raja Baragaon ka bhi nirmata mani jata hai.

qe: Over the low plain the old Asuren embankment near Rajgir extends for about what distance, ending about a mile before it reaches Rajagriha?
qh: नीचे के मैदान में पुराना असुरेन बाँध लगभग कितनी दूर तक फैला है, जो राजगृह पहुँचने से लगभग एक मील पहले समाप्त हो जाता है?
e: Yah purana seedha bandh, jise log Asuren kehte hain, sirf neeche wale maidan me faila hua hai; iski lambai lagbhag char mile hai. Rajagriha pahunchne se takriban ek mile pehle hi yah khatam ho jata hai, kyunki wahan zameen uthni shuru ho jati hai. Barish ke mausam me iske aur pahad ke beech ka ilaaka ek jheel jaisa ban jata hai, aur sookhe mausam me jheel sookh kar uski tali me kheti hone lagti hai; pani kai jagah se iski vedi ko tod deta hai, isliye aane-jaane wale chhote pull bana kar bhar dete hain. Yahi baat dikhati hai ki yah ek vyavasthit badi rachna thi, jiska asli uddeshya raja ke liye ek shreshth aane ka marg banana tha. Exam point: Asuren bandh neeche ke maidan me lagbhag char mile tak chalta hai aur Rajagriha se lagbhag ek mile pehle khatam ho jata hai.

qe: The fort at Rajgir attributed by tradition to Sher Shah occupies the south-west corner of the older fort and measures about what?
qh: राजगीर का वह किला, जिसे परंपरा शेरशाह से जोड़ती है, पुराने किले के दक्षिण-पश्चिम कोने में है और लगभग कितना बड़ा है?
e: Rajgir me ek chhota qila hai, jise parampara Sher Shah se jodti hai. Yah bahari purane qile ke dakshin-pashchim kone me, lagbhag 600 gaj ke chaturbhuj kshetra me bana hua hai. Iske pashchim aur dakshin ke chehre purani rampart ke hi aage badhe hue bhaag hain, jinhe mazboot kiya gaya tha; inki satah par jagah-jagah eentein dikhti hain, jo sambhavtah upar ki mend yaani parapet ki rahi hongi. Jahan purani mitti ki vedi me gap the, wahan pahad ke bade-bade kache pattharon ki nayi deewar khadi kar di gayi thi; yah nayi deewar lagbhag 16 feet chaudi thi, lekin ab kaafi toot chuki hai. Purani mitti ki vedi par jagah-jagah patthar ki chhoti platform bhi bichhayi gayi thi, jis par eenton ki mend ka base bana hota tha. Exam point: Rajgir ka chhota qila, jo parampara me Sher Shah se juda hai, bahari purane qile ke dakshin-pashchim kone me lagbhag 600 gaj ke kshetra me bana hua hai.

qe: How long before did the Sravakas of Rajgir place Raja Senak, the builder of the fort?
qh: राजगीर के श्रावक किले के निर्माता राजा सेनक को कितने वर्ष पहले हुआ बताते थे?
e: Rajgir ke Sravak logon ki parampara me raja Senak ya Srenik ko 2,603 saal pehle hua bataya gaya. Unneesvin sadi ke aarambh me ki gayi ganana ke hisab se yah samay Isvi poorv ki panchvin-shavi sadi ke aas-paas banta hai, jo Magadha ke raja Bimbisara ka swabhavik samay hai, kyunki Bimbisara ka rajkal lagbhag 528 se 500 Isvi poorv tak mana jata hai. Sravak log is raja ko Jarasandha se bahut baad ka batate hain, aur Jarasandha ke baare me unka vishwas tha ki woh Ayodhya me rahta tha. Is tarah sthaniya parampara ka yah varnan itihas ke un nishkarshon se milta hai, jinme Rajgriha ko Bimbisara ki rajdhani bataya jata hai. Exam point: Sravak parampara Rajgir qile ke nirmata Raja Senak ko apne samay se 2,603 saal pehle ka batati hai, jo Isvi poorv ki panchvin-shavi sadi ke aas-paas ka samay banta hai.

qe: The earthen mass of the rampart of the fort attributed to Sher Shah at Rajgir was above what size?
qh: राजगीर के शेरशाह से जुड़े किले की मिट्टी की परकोटा-दीवार कितनी बड़ी थी?
oe: Above 100 feet wide and 50 feet high
Above 30 feet wide and 60 feet high
Above 60 feet wide and 30 feet high
Above 60 feet wide and 60 feet high
oh: 100 फुट से ज़्यादा चौड़ी और 50 फुट ऊँची
30 फुट से ज़्यादा चौड़ी और 60 फुट ऊँची
60 फुट से ज़्यादा चौड़ी और 30 फुट ऊँची
60 फुट से ज़्यादा चौड़ी और 60 फुट ऊँची
e: Sher Shah se jude Rajgir ke chhote qile ki deewar dekhte hi samajh me aata hai ki wahan mitti hi zyada lagi hai. Us mitti ke dher ki chaudai lagbhag 60 feet se zyada thi aur oonchai lagbhag 30 feet thi. Is vedi ki upari satah par eentein dikhti hain, jo sambhavtah parapet yaani upar ki suraksha-mend ki thi; lekin in pattharon ke alawa koi darwaza ya mazboot burj yahan nahi mila. Jahan rampart me gap the, wahan pahad ke bade kache pattharon se nayi deewar khadi ki gayi thi, jo ab bahut toot chuki hai. Itne kam samay me itni adhik toot-phoot hone ke kaaran hi kai vidwan is qile ko Sher Shah ka nirman maanne me sandeh karte hain. Exam point: Sher Shah se jude Rajgir qile ke mitti ke rampart ki chaudai 60 feet se zyada aur oonchai lagbhag 30 feet thi.

qe: Besides all the images of Siva, Ganesa and Surya, the Sravakas of Rajgir claimed which natural feature as their own?
qh: शिव, गणेश और सूर्य की सभी प्रतिमाओं के अलावा राजगीर के श्रावक किस प्राकृतिक वस्तु को अपना बताते थे?
e: Rajgir me garam paani ke jharne, yaani hot springs, aaj bhi mashhoor hain, jinhe log tapasya aur rog-nivaran se jodte hain. Un dino Rajgir ke Sravak yaani Jain anuyayi apne aap ko us kshetra ki sabhi dev-moortiyon aur sadhanon ka adhikari maante the. Unka daava tha ki Siva, Ganesa, Surya aadi ki sabhi moortiyan aur Rajgir ke sabhi garam jharne unke hain; iske viparit unhe Buddha ke baare me kuchh bhi pata nahi tha, yaani unki parampara me Buddha ko koi khaas sthan nahi diya jata tha. Yah baat dikhati hai ki us samay Rajgir kshetra me Shaiv, Vaishnav aur Jain paramparaon ka mail-jol tha, aur ek hi sthal ke upasak alag-alag dev-moortiyon par apna daava jataate the. Exam point: Rajgir ke Sravak Siva, Ganesa aur Surya ki sabhi moortiyon ke saath sabhi garam jharnon par apna daava karte the, par Buddha ke baare me unhe kuchh pata nahi tha.

qe: Which faces of the fort attributed to Sher Shah at Rajgir had no ditch at all?
qh: राजगीर के शेरशाह से जुड़े किले के किन भागों के सामने खाई बिल्कुल नहीं थी?
e: Rajgir ke us chhote qile, jise parampara Sher Shah se jodti hai, ke charon taraf khai nahi khodi gayi thi. Iske pashchim aur dakshin chehre purani mitti ki vedi ke hi nirman the, jinhe mazboot kiya gaya tha. Puri purab ki taraf ki deewar pahad ke bade-bade kache pattharon se bani thi, jiski motai lagbhag 18 feet thi; usme thodi-thodi doori par adhachandrakar yaani aadhe gol ubhaar banaye gaye the. Uttar ki deewar ka purabi aadha hissa bhi isi patthar ki chunai se bana tha, jabki uska pashchimi sira eenton se bana tha. Sabse badi baat yah hai ki in purabi aur uttari chehron ke aage-peeche koi khai nahi thi, jise dekh kar hi vidwan ise Sher Shah ka citadel maanne me hichakate hain. Exam point: Sher Shah se jude Rajgir qile ke purabi aur uttari chehron par koi khai nahi thi; purabi deewar lagbhag 18 feet moti tatha kache pattharon ki bani thi.

qe: What chiefly made it doubtful that the smaller fort at Rajgir was built by Sher Shah?
qh: राजगीर के छोटे किले को शेरशाह का बनवाया मानने में मुख्य संदेह किस बात से होता है?
oe: It was built entirely of stone without any earth
Its bricks were of a much later size and pattern
It contained a temple of a Hindu deity inside
No trace of any gate building survived and the ditch was not carried round it
oh: वह बिना मिट्टी के पूरी तरह पत्थर से बना था
उसकी ईंटें बहुत बाद के आकार और बनावट की थीं
उसके अंदर एक हिंदू देवता का मंदिर था
किसी दरवाज़े की इमारत का कोई चिन्ह नहीं बचा और उसके चारों ओर खाई नहीं चलाई गई
e: Rajgir ke chhote qile ko parampara Sher Shah se jodti hai, lekin is baat par sandeh hota hai, kyunki Sher Shah ke samay se abhi bahut kam samay beeta tha, phir bhi qile ki deewarein bahut zyada toot chuki thi. Sabse bada sandeh yah tha ki jahan-jahan rampart me gap dikhte hain, jinhe darwazon ke liye banaya gaya hoga, wahan ek bhi darwaze ki imarat ka koi chinh bacha nahi tha. Dusri baat, agar chhota qila shahar se zyada mazboot ek sainya-kshetra hota, to khai uske charon taraf bhi jaari rehti; lekin aisa nahi tha. Iske alawa kuchh gap patthar ki nayi deewar se bhare gaye the, jo dikhata hai ki wahan baad me marammat hui thi. Exam point: Chhote Rajgir qile par Sher Shah ke nirman hone ka sandeh is kaaran tha ki kisi darwaze ki imarat ka chinh nahi bacha tha aur khai uske charon taraf nahi chalayi gayi thi.

qe: The water of the Brahmakund at Rajgir was found at about what temperature on a day when the air in the shade stood at 62 degrees?
qh: राजगीर के ब्रह्मकुंड का जल उस दिन लगभग कितने तापमान पर पाया गया, जब छाया में हवा 62 डिग्री पर थी?
e: Brahmakund Rajgir ke garam jharnon me sabse mashhoor hai. Yah ek chaturbhuj cistern yaani paani jama karne wala kund hai, jo bahut gehra hai aur jiska nirman kuchh hisse me patthar se aur kuchh hisse me eenton se hua hai. Paani kund ki tali me ikattha hota hai, aur us paani ka taapman lagbhag 109 degree paya gaya, jabki usi samay chhaya me hawa ka taapman 62 degree tha. Kund ki deewar me Ganesa ki ek moorti bhi jadi hui hai. Itna garam paani hone ka kaaran yah hai ki yah jharne zameen ke andar gehari dararon se nikalte hain; aise sthal upasana ke saath-saath chikitsa ke liye bhi mahatvapurna maane jaate the. Exam point: Brahmakund ka paani lagbhag 109 degree par paya gaya, jabki chhaya me hawa 62 degree thi.

qe: Below the terrace near the Brahmakund at Rajgir lies a square brick reservoir in which how many sacred springs issue from stone spouts?
qh: राजगीर के ब्रह्मकुंड के पास की वेदी के नीचे एक वर्गाकार ईंटों का कुंड है, जिसमें पत्थर के मुँहों से कितने पवित्र जल-स्रोत निकलते हैं?
e: Brahmakund ke paas ek vargakar yaani square kund hai, jo eenton se bana hai aur jisme paanch pavitra jharne patthar ke muhon se nikalte hain. Unke naam hai Panchanon, Kasi, Handa Mod ya Langai, Panchanod aur Gaumukhi. Inme Panchanon aur Gaumukhi sookh gaye the. Kasi ka paani 107 degree aur Handa Mod ka 101 degree paya gaya, jabki Panchanod ka 94 degree. Paani ko bahne diya jata hai, isliye woh saaf aur bilkul bina swad ka rahta hai; kund me ruk kar jama paani ganda ho jata hai. Kund me Surya ki ek moorti bhi padi hui thi. Exam point: Brahmakund ke paas ke vargakar kund me paanch pavitra jharne patthar ke muhon se nikalte hain.

qe: In the long narrow brick reservoir west of the Brahmakund at Rajgir, which of the springs raised the thermometer to 110 degrees?
qh: राजगीर के ब्रह्मकुंड के पश्चिम स्थित लंबे-संकरे ईंटों के कुंड के जल-स्रोतों में किसने तापमान 110 डिग्री तक पहुँचाया?
e: Brahmakund ke pashchim me ek lamba aur sankra kund hai, jise eenton se banaya gaya hai aur jisme saat pavitra jharne patthar ke muhon se nikalte hain. Is kund ka pehla jharana Gautam kehlata hai, jiska tapan 104 degree tha; doosra jharana Baraduyari bhi isi tapan par tha. Teesra jharana Viswamitra tha, jisne thermometer ko 110 degree tak pahunchaya. Isi kund ke aakhri teen jharne Durhasa, Vasishtha aur Parasari sookh gaye the. Ek hi kshetra ke jharnon ke tapan me itna antar yah dikhata hai ki ve alag-alag bhu-garbhiya dararon se aate the, isliye sabhi jharne ek hi tapan ke nahi hote. Exam point: Lamba kund ka teesra jharana Viswamitra tha, jisne thermometer ko 110 degree tak pahunchaya.

qe: The circular mound west of the fort at Rajgir, with a small cavity surrounded by an earthen rampart carrying broken bricks, was most probably what kind of work?
qh: राजगीर के किले के पश्चिम स्थित गोल टीला, जिसमें एक छोटी गुहा और टूटी ईंटों वाला मिट्टी का परकोटा है, सबसे संभवतः किस प्रकार की रचना थी?
oe: The capital of a later raja
oh: किसी बाद के राजा की राजधानी
e: Rajgir ke qile ke thik pashchim me ek gol teela hai, jisme ek chhoti si gopha hai aur jiske charon taraf mitti ka parakota hai, jis par kuchh tooti hui eentein padi hain. Brahmanon ka kehna tha ki yah ek math yaani sadhu ke rahne ka sthal tha, jo ek Dandi naam ke tapasvi ne banwaya, lekin yah vichar theek nahi lagta kyunki ek ghar itna bada khandahar nahi chhodta. Us parakote ki banawat qile ki praachir se bilkul milti hai, aur dono ke beech sirf khai hai; isliye yah sabse sambhavtah qile ka ek bahari suraksha-kshetra tha. Pahadon ke beech ki darar se nikal kar aane wali ek chhoti nadi us purani khai se hokar bahti thi. Exam point: Qile ke pashchim wala gol teela uski banawat ke kaaran sabse sambhavtah qile ka bahari suraksha-kshetra yaani outwork tha.

qe: Where did the Rajbansi tradition of Rajagriha place the residence of Jarasandha?
qh: राजगृह की राजवंशी परंपरा जरासंध का निवास कहाँ मानती थी?
e: Rajagriha ke Rajvanshi logon ki apni ek parampara thi. Shahar ke paas se jaane wale us purane seedhe bandh ke baare me, jise aam taur par Jarasandha se joda jata hai, unka kehna tha ki use kisi begane raja ne banwaya tha. Lekin Jarasandha ke rahne ke sthal ke baare me unki manyata yah thi ki woh Giriak me rahta tha, na ki Rajgir ke qile me. Unki parampara ke mutabik yah kshetra pehle ek Raja ka tha, phir ek Brahman parivar ka ho gaya, jise pahad ke devtaon ki pooja ke liye Maharashtra se bulaya gaya tha, aur unhe poora pargana diya gaya, jo baad me unse chhin liya gaya. Exam point: Rajgriha ke Rajvanshi log Jarasandha ka nivas-sthal Giriak batate the, na ki Rajgir ka qila.

qe: In which cave at Rajgir was the first great Buddhist council held, soon after the death of Buddha, to fix the tenets of the faith?
qh: बुद्ध के देहांत के तुरंत बाद धर्म के सिद्धांत तय करने के लिए राजगीर की किस गुफा में प्रथम महान बौद्ध संगीति हुई?
e: Buddha ke dehant ke baad, lagbhag 487 Isvi poorv me, Rajgir ki Sattapanni gufa me pehla bada Bauddh sangiti hua, jiska uddeshya Buddha ke updeshon ke sidhanton ko tay karna tha. Sattapanni ka matlab sapta-parni yaani saat patte wala vriksh hai. Bauddh sangiti ka matlab hota hai bhikshuon ka bada sammelan, jisme dharmagranthon ko saath-saath bol kar yaad rakha jata tha. Is sangiti me Ajatasatru ne sahayog diya, aur isi ki disha me aage Vaishali tatha Pataliputra me bhi sangitiyan hui. Rajgir Bauddh itihas ka mahatvapurna kendra tha, kyunki yahin Buddha ne updesh diye aur yahin unke dehant ke baad pehli sangiti hui. Exam point: Pehli mahan Bauddh sangiti Rajgir ki Sattapanni gufa me hui, jisme Buddha ke updeshon ke sidhant tay kiye gaye.

qe: Ajatasatru built a new capital to the north of the old city of Rajgir and erected a stupa over what?
qh: अजातशत्रु ने राजगीर के पुराने नगर के उत्तर में नई राजधानी बनाई और किस वस्तु पर स्तूप बनवाया?
oe: His share of the ashes of Buddha
oh: बुद्ध की अस्थियों में मिला उसका हिस्सा
e: Buddha ke dehant ke baad unki asthiyan aur avshesh kai hisson me baant diye gaye. Ajatasatru ko bhi Buddha ki asthiyon ka ek hissa mila, aur usne apni nayi rajdhani me us hisse par ek stupa banwaya. Stupa ek gumbad-numa smarak hota hai, jisme dharmik shreshth vyakti ke avshesh athva smriti-chinh rakhe jate the. Ajatasatru ne purane nagar ke uttar me nayi rajdhani bhi basayi, jise New Rajgir ya naya Rajgir kaha jata hai. Isi prakar Buddha ke dharm ka rajkul se gahra sambandh bana aur Magadha me Bauddh smarakon ki parampara shuru hui. Baad me Asoka jaise shasakon ne aise stupon se avshesh nikaal kar unhe desh bhar me phailaya. Exam point: Ajatasatru ne Buddha ki asthiyon me mile apne hisse par stupa banwaya, aur usi ke samay purane Rajgir ke uttar me nayi rajdhani basi.

qe: The zig-zag stone road on the hills at Rajgriha, which people pointed out as the wall of the old city, was found to consist of how many bends?
qh: राजगृह की पहाड़ियों पर बना टेढ़ा-मेढ़ा पत्थर का मार्ग, जिसे लोग पुराने नगर की दीवार बताते थे, कितने मोड़ों वाला निकला?
e: Rajgriha aur Giriak dono jagah pahadiyon par patthar se bane tede-medhe dhanche dikhte hain, jinhe log purane nagar ki deewar batate the. Lekin inhe dhyan se dekhne par saaf ho gaya ki ye deewarein nahi, raaste the, jo pahadiyon ke beech se guzar kar dono jagahon ko aapas me jodte the. Rajgriha ka jo route naapa gaya, usme paanch mod the, poori lambai lagbhag 1,200 hath ki thi, har mod par ek gol kuchaar aaram karne ka sthal tha, aur uski chaudai chaar hath thi. Hath yaani cubit lambai ki purani ikai hai, jo lagbhag atharah inch ke barabar hoti hai. Baad me yah marg ghaas-phoos se dhak gaya, isliye aage uske chinh nahi milte. Exam point: Pahadiyon ka teda-medha patthar ka marg purane nagar ki deewar nahi balki paanch modon wala raasta tha, jiski lambai lagbhag 1,200 hath thi.

qe: The Chinese pilgrim Fa Hian, visiting Rajgir in the fifth century A.D., found the old city in what condition?
qh: पाँचवीं शताब्दी ईसवी में राजगीर आए चीनी यात्री फाह्यान ने पुराने नगर की क्या स्थिति देखी?
oe: Buried under a landslip from the hills
oh: पहाड़ियों से आए भूस्खलन में दबा हुआ
e: Fa Hian Bharat me paanchvin sadi Isvi ke aarambh me aaye the. Rajgir pahunchne par unhone paya ki purana nagar veeran tha aur usme koi nivasi nahi rah gaya tha, lekin naye nagar me do vihar yaani bauddh math maujood the, aur Buddha ki asthiyon par bana stupa ab bhi khada tha. Unka yah varnan batata hai ki Bauddh dharm ke patan ke baad bhi Rajgir ek yatra-sthal bana raha. Do sadi baad aaye Hiuen Tsiang ne yahan isse bhi zyada toot-phoot dekhi, jisme purane nagar ki bahari deewarein khandhar ban chuki thi. Aise yaatriyon ke varnan hi Bharat ke prachin itihas ke bahut mahatvapurna pramaan mane jate hain. Exam point: Fa Hian ne Rajgir ke purane nagar ko veeran aur nivasiyon se rahit paya, jabki naye nagar me do vihar aur Buddha ki asthiyon wala stupa maujood the.

qe: Which community came to Rajagriha guided by their books and regarded it as the residence of Jarasandha, one of the most religious princes of their faith?
qh: कौन-सा समुदाय अपनी पुस्तकों के निर्देश पर राजगृह आया और उसे अपने धर्म के सबसे धार्मिक राजकुमारों में से एक जरासंध का निवास मानता था?
oe: The Buddhists of Ava in Burma
e: Ava Burma ki ek purani rajdhani thi, aur wahan ke Bauddh logon ki apni dharmik parampara aur granth the. Unke granthon ke nirdesh par woh Rajgriha aaye aur us sthal ko Jarasandha ka niwas manate the, jise woh apne dharm ke sabse dharmik raj-kumaron me se ek batate the. Yah baat dikhati hai ki prachin Bharat ke tirth-sthalon ka asar doosre deshon ki Bauddh paramparaon par bhi pada aur woh apne granthon ke aadhar par Bharat me aakar in sthalon ko pehchante the. Rajgriha ki sthiti pahadiyon ke beech hone ke kaaran ek kila-numa suraksha deti thi, isliye teenon bade Hindu sampraday bhi ise apna pasandida sthal batate the. Exam point: Ava (Burma) ke Bauddh apne granthon ke nirdesh par Rajgriha aate the aur us sthal ko Jarasandha ka niwas manate the.

qe: When Hiuen Tsiang visited Rajgir in the seventh century, by whom did he find the place inhabited?
qh: सातवीं शताब्दी में राजगीर आए ह्वेनसांग ने यहाँ किन लोगों की बस्ती पाई?
oh: लगभग एक हजार ब्राह्मण परिवारों की
दस विहारों में रहने वाले बौद्ध भिक्षुओं की
किलों में रहने वाले राजपूत सरदारों की
e: Saatvin sadi Isvi ke madhy me aaye chini yaatri Hiuen Tsiang ne Rajgir ki bahut badi toot-phoot dekhi. Unke varnan ke mutabik purane shahar ki andaruni deewarein ab bhi khadi thi, lekin bahari deewarein khandhar ban chuki thi. Wahan keval Brahman hi rah gaye the, jinki sankhya lagbhag ek hazaar parivar batayi gayi hai. Phir bhi yah sthal yatra ka ek lokapriya kendra bana raha, aur pavitra jharnon ke aas-paas kai stupa tatha vihar ban chuke the. Is varnan se pata chalta hai ki Rajgir me Bauddh prabhutva ghat kar Brahman prabhutva badh gayi thi, aur sthal ek dharmik-sanskritik mail-jol ka kendra ban gaya tha. Exam point: Hiuen Tsiang ne saatvin sadi me Rajgir me lagbhag ek hazaar Brahman parivaron ki basti payi, jabki andaruni deewarein khadi thi aur bahari deewarein khandhar thi.

qe: The water of the Surjokund at Rajgir was found at what heat, being then collected in a pool and not falling from a spout?
qh: राजगीर के सूर्यकुंड का जल किस ताप पर पाया गया, जो उस समय किसी मुँह से गिरने के बजाय एक हौज में इकट्ठा हो रहा था?
e: Surjokund yaani Surya ka kund Rajgir ke uttari pahadi ke pashchim sire par bane jharnon aur chhote mandiron ke samuh me hai. Is kund me paani kisi patthar ke muh se nahi girta, balki ek hoz me ikattha hota hai, isliye woh ganda ho jata hai aur usme mendhak aadi jeev bhar jate hain. Iska tapan 103 degree naapa gaya. Kund ki deewar me Surya ki ek moorti jadi hui hai, jo Kasi Tirtha ki moorti se kuchh alag hai; uske paas ek mota purush ki moorti hai jiska ek pair singhasan par latka hua hai, aur uske charon or ek abhilekh khuda hai. Surya ke charnon ke aage Buddha ki ek chhoti moorti rakhi gayi thi, jo dikhati hai ki is sthal par alag-alag upasana-dharaon ki moortiyan ek saath rakhi jati thi. Exam point: Surjokund ka paani 103 degree tapan par paya gaya, aur wahan Surya ki moorti ke charnon ke aage Buddha ki chhoti moorti rakhi hui mili.

qe: The old capital of Jarasandha, a name preserved in the Ramayana and the Mahabharata, was known by what, meaning the mountain-girt city?
qh: रामायण और महाभारत में सुरक्षित जरासंध की पुरानी राजधानी का क्या नाम था, जिसका अर्थ पहाड़ों से घिरा नगर है?
e: Rajgir ko samay-samay par kai naam se jana jata raha. Jarasandha ki purani rajdhani ka naam Giribraja tha, jiska matlab hai pahadon se ghira hua nagar ya bahut pahadiyon ka nagar; yah naam Ramayana aur Mahabharata dono me surakshit hai. Baad me jab Saisunak rajvansh ne ise apni rajdhani banaya, tab ise Rajagriha yaani raj-niwas kaha jane laga. Bimbisara ke purane nagar ka naam Kusagarapura tha aur Ajatasatru ki rajdhani ko New Rajgir kaha jata hai. Yahi naam aaj bhi chalte hain, aur aadhunik gaon Ajatasatru ke nagar ke sthal par basta hai. Is tarah ek hi sthal ke kai naam uske itihas ki alag-alag avadhiyon ki yaad dilate hain. Exam point: Jarasandha ki purani rajdhani Giribraja kehlati thi, jiska matlab pahadon se ghira nagar hai, aur yah naam Ramayana tatha Mahabharata me bhi milta hai.

qe: The ancient city of Bimbisara at Rajgir, now called Old Rajgir, was known by which name meaning the city of kusa grass?
qh: राजगीर में बिंबिसार का प्राचीन नगर, जिसे अब पुराना राजगीर कहते हैं, किस नाम से जाना जाता था, जिसका अर्थ कुश घास का नगर है?
e: Kusa ek pavitra ghaas hai, jiska upyog prachin Bharat me dharmik karyon aur havan me hota tha. Bimbisara ke samay ke nagar ko Kusagarapura yaani kusa-ghaas ka nagar kaha jata tha, aur aaj use purana Rajgir kehte hain. Ajatasatru ki rajdhani ko naya Rajgir kaha jata hai. Ye dono naam bahut purane hain, kyunki paanchvin sadi ke Fa Hian aur saatvin sadi ke Hiuen Tsiang ke varnan me bhi yahi naam milte hain. Is tarah Bimbisara ka nagar ghati ke andar pahadon ke beech basa tha, jabki naya nagar ghati ke bahar uttari dwar ke paas bana tha, aur dono ke beech lagbhag do-tihai mile ki doori thi. Exam point: Bimbisara ke nagar ka naam Kusagarapura tha, jiska matlab kusa ghaas ka nagar hai, aur yahi aaj purana Rajgir kehlata hai.

qe: The fine spring near Rajgir called Vanur Vanuri takes its name from the story that what happened there?
qh: राजगीर के पास वनुर वनुरी नाम का साफ जल का झरना किस लोक-कथा से अपना नाम पाता है?
oe: Buddha rested here on his way to the Vulture Peak
A raja was cured of leprosy there
A monkey and his wife were carried to heaven after bathing in it
oh: बुद्ध ने गिद्धशिखर जाते समय यहाँ विश्राम किया
एक राजा को यहाँ कुष्ठ रोग से मुक्ति मिली
इस कुंड की रक्षा एक सर्प करता था
एक बंदर और उसकी पत्नी इसी में स्नान करके सीधे स्वर्ग पहुँच गए
e: Brahmakund ke paas hi, usi kinare par thoda aur upar, chattan me kaate gaye ek chhote chaukor hoje se ek saaf paani ka jharna nikalta hai. Iska naam Vanur Vanuri hai, jo vanar yaani bandar se bana hai. Lok-katha ke mutabik ek bandar aur uski patni isi kund me snan karne ke kaaran seedhe svarg pahunch gaye the, aur isi se is jharne ka naam pada. Aise kshetriya aakhyaan prachin Bharat me jharnon tatha nadiyon ko pavitra banane ka aam tareeka the. Isi parivesh me thoda aage jal-dhara do dhaaron me bat jati hai aur beech ke teele par Jamdevi ki tooti moorti mili thi. Exam point: Vanur Vanuri jharne ka naam is lok-katha se pada ki ek bandar aur uski patni us kund me snan karne par seedhe svarg pahunch gaye the.

qe: The prehistoric outer walls of the old city of Rajgir are usually how thick, being faced with massive undressed stones set without mortar?
qh: पुराने राजगीर के प्रागैतिहासिक बाहरी परकोटे की मोटाई सामान्यतः कितनी थी, जो बिना गारे के जड़े विशाल कच्चे पत्थरों से बने थे?
e: Rajgir ke sabse purane avshesh uske pragaithihasik bahari parakote hain, jo apne bhaari aur kachche nirman ke kaaran cyclopean yaani 'dev-kal' ki deewar kehlate hain. Ye deewarein sada mitti ya gare ke bina khade kiye gaye bade-bade kachche pattharon se bani thi, aur inki motai samanya roop se lagbhag saadhe satrah feet hoti thi. Ye aksar pahadiyon ki chotiyon ke bahari kinare par banayi gayi thi, jisse dushman ke liye chadhna mushkil ho jaye. Inmein se kuchh deewarein Bimbisara ke nagar ki sthapna se bhi pehle ki hain, isliye yah Rajgir ke sabse purane nirman-chinh mane jate hain. Aisi deewaron ka banaya jana us samay ki vyavasthit shram-shakti tatha sangathan ka pramaan hai. Exam point: Purane Rajgir ke bahari parakote lagbhag saadhe satrah feet mote the aur bina gare ke jade kachche pattharon se bane the.

qe: The inner ramparts of the old city in the Rajgir valley had a circuit of about how much, while the outer line ran for twenty-five miles along the hill crests?
qh: राजगीर की घाटी में पुराने नगर के भीतरी परकोटे की परिधि लगभग कितनी थी, जबकि बाहरी रेखा पहाड़ियों की चोटियों पर पच्चीस मील तक फैली थी?
e: Rajgir me kila-bandhi ki do pramukh rekha thi. Ghati ke andar nagar ke bhitari parakote yaani rampart ki paridhi lagbhag paanch mile thi, jisme Bimbisara ke samay nagar basa tha. Iske bahar pahadiyon ki chotiyon par kile ki ek aur bahari rekha thi, jo lagbhag pachchis mile tak chalti thi aur Giriak tak pahunchti thi. Yah bahari rekha pahadiyon ki aisi hi khadi dhalano ka upyog karti thi, aur Rajgir ghati ko Jethian ghati se alag karne wali dakshin-pashchim dhalan par bhi poori tarah bani hui thi. Aisi vishal parikrama wali kile-bandhi dikhati hai ki prachin Magadha ke log pahadiyon ki praakritik suraksha ko kile ki deewaron se jod kar ek mazboot raksha-praali banate the. Exam point: Ghati ke andar bhitari parakote ki paridhi lagbhag paanch mile thi, jabki bahari rekha pahadiyon ki chotiyon par pachchis mile tak faili thi.

qe: New Rajgir, the capital of Ajatasatru, was protected by a wall of massive stone blocks and had the shape of what?
qh: अजातशत्रु की राजधानी नए राजगीर की सुरक्षा विशाल पत्थरों की दीवार से होती थी और उसका आकार कैसा था?
e: Naya Rajgir ghati ke uttari dwar ke bahar, purane nagar se lagbhag do-tihai mile ki doori par basa tha. Iske charon taraf thos patthar ke bade-bade ghaton se chunwa gehari deewar thi, aur iska aakar ek aniyamit panchbhuj ke jaisa tha. Iski paridhi lagbhag teen mile thi. Dakshin taraf pahadiyon ki or nagar ka ek hissa alag kar usme ek citadel yaani antah-pur bana tha, jahan patthar ki deewarein aaj bhi kaafi surakshit halat me maujood hain. Ajatasatru ne ise apni rajdhani banaya tha, aur yah sthal aaj bhi naye Rajgir ke naam se jana jata hai. Aisi thos chunai vali deewar Magadha ki sainya-vaastu-kala ka achha udaharan hai. Exam point: Naye Rajgir ki deewar thos patthar ke ghaton se bani thi aur uska aakar ek aniyamit panchbhuj ke jaisa tha, jiski paridhi lagbhag teen mile thi.

qe: Evidence from the Burmese records placed the garden of Jivaka, the king's physician, outside which gate of the old city of Rajgir, north of the road to the Vulture's Peak?
qh: बर्मी अभिलेखों के प्रमाण राजा के वैद्य जीवक के उद्यान को राजगीर के पुराने नगर के किस द्वार के बाहर, गिद्धशिखर जाने वाली सड़क के उत्तर में रखते हैं?
e: Jivaka Magadha ke raja Bimbisara ka vaidya tha aur Bauddh granthon me uski bahut charcha hai; usne ek udyan banwaya tha, jise Amravan yaani aam ka bagh kaha jata tha. Burma ke Bauddh granthon ke aadhar par yah udyan purane nagar ke purabi dwar ke bahar, Gridhrakuta yaani Giddh-shikhar ki or jane wali sadak ke uttar me tha. Purane nagar ki purabi deewar ke samne se ek sadak nikalti thi, jo ek gehre ghere yaani khai ko ek pul se paarti thi, aur us pul ki neev ke chinh aaj bhi dikhte hain. Is varnan se prachin Rajgir ke nagar-nirman tatha uske dwar-bandi prabandh ki jaankari milti hai. Exam point: Jivaka ka udyan purane Rajgir ke purabi dwar ke bahar, Giddh-shikhar ki sadak ke uttar me tha.

qe: The stone causeway leading up to the Gridhrakuta hill at Rajgir, on which traces of two stupas remain, is known by which name?
qh: राजगीर की गिद्धशिखर पहाड़ी तक जाने वाले पत्थर के चबूतरे-मार्ग को, जिस पर दो स्तूपों के चिन्ह मिलते हैं, किस नाम से जाना जाता है?
e: Gridhrakuta yaani Giddh-shikhar Rajgir ke paanch pahadiyon me Chhathagiri pahadi hai. Is pahadi tak pahunchne wale patthar ke chabutre-marg ko Bimbisara marg kaha jata hai, kyunki parampara me yah raja Bimbisara se juda hai. Is marg par do stupon ke chinh aaj bhi milte hain, jinhe 'Rath se utarna' tatha 'Bheed ko wapas bhejna' kaha jata tha; yeh Buddha ke Rajgir lautne se jude smriti-sthal the. Pahadi ke pashchim sire par khadi chattan ke kinare wale vihar ka varnan bhi Hiuen Tsiang ne kiya hai, aur Buddha ne yahin se kai updesh diye the, isliye Giddh-shikhar Bauddh tirth ka ek sabse mahatvapurna sthal tha. Exam point: Giddh-shikhar tak jane wale patthar ke chabutre-marg ko Bimbisara marg kaha jata hai, jis par do stupon ke chinh milte hain.

qe: Mahendra, the younger brother of Asoka, lived the life of an anchorite on which hill at Rajgir, on one of whose holy hills Asoka himself is said to have died in 282 B.C.?
qh: अशोक के छोटे भाई महेंद्र ने राजगीर की किस पहाड़ी पर तपस्वी का जीवन बिताया, जिसकी किसी पवित्र पहाड़ी पर स्वयं अशोक ने 282 ईसा पूर्व में देह त्याग किया माना जाता है?
e: Mahendra, jo samraat Asoka ka chhota bhai tha, ne apne jeevan ka kaafi hissa Rajgir ki Giddh-shikhar pahadi par ek kandara me tapasvi ke roop me bitaya. Tapasvi yaani anchorite ka matlab hai woh vyakti jo sansarik jeevan chhod kar ekaant me tapasya karta hai. Kaha jata hai ki Asoka svayan bhi 282 Isvi poorv me Giddh-shikhar ki ek pavitra pahadi par hi unka dehant hua, aisa kaha jata hai. Asoka ka Bauddh dharm ke prasar me bada yogdan tha, aur Mahendra ka naam vishesh roop se is baat se juda hai ki unhi ne Bauddh dharm Ceylon tak pahunchane me mahatvapurna bhumika nibhai. Rajgir ke aise varnan dikhate hain ki Maurya kaal me bhi yah sthal Bauddhon ka ek bada kendra bana raha. Exam point: Mahendra ne Giddh-shikhar par tapasvi ka jeevan bitaya, aur Asoka ke 282 Isvi poorv me isi pahadi ki ek pavitra choti par marne ki baat kahi jati hai.

qe: The cyclopean outer walls of the old city of Rajgir are in best preservation on the southern ridge on either side of the gap of which stream?
qh: पुराने राजगीर के नगर की साइक्लोपियन बाहरी दीवारें दक्षिणी श्रेणी पर किस नदी-नाले की दरार के दोनों ओर सबसे अच्छी हालत में मिलती हैं?
e: Rajgir ki pahadiyon ke beech se kai chhote jharne aur nadein nikalte hain. Inme ek Bawan Ganga hai, jo pahadiyon ke beech ki darar se hokar aage badhti hai, aur yahi darar Bawan Ganga gap ke naam se jani jati hai. Purane nagar ke parakote isi darar ke dono kinaron par dakshin pahadi-shrung par sabse achhi halat me bache hue hain. Bahari deewar ki rekha purb me Giriak tak pahunchti hai, jahan Bawan Ganga viduyt ke paas Panchana nadi me mil jati hai. Aisi vishal deewar-bandhi se pata chalta hai ki prachin kal me bhi pahadiyon ki praakritik rekhaon ko dekh kar suraksha ki yojana banayi jati thi. Exam point: Bawan Ganga ki darar ke dono or dakshin shreni par purane Rajgir ke parakote sabse behtar halat me milte hain.

qe: Which dwelling at Rajgir, identified with the small flat-topped stone fort and the cavern behind it, is said in Buddhist tradition to have been lived in by Buddha and has several small cells in its walls?
qh: राजगीर में वह कौन-सा निवास है, जिसे छोटे चपटे-शीर्ष वाले पत्थर के किले तथा उसके पीछे की गुफा से पहचाना जाता है और जिसमें बुद्ध के रहने की बौद्ध परंपरा है तथा जिसकी दीवारों में कई छोटी कोठरियाँ हैं?
e: Rajgir ki Baibhar pahadi par ek chhota chapte-shirsh wala patthar ka kila hai, aur uske peeche ek gufa hai. Unneesvin sadi ke aakhir me is sthal ko Pippal patthar-grih tatha Asuron ki gufa se pehchana gaya. Bauddh parampara ke mutabik Buddha svayan is Pippal patthar-grih me rahe the, aur iski deewaron me kai chhoti kothriyan bani hui hain. Yah sthal is baat ka pramaan hai ki prachin Rajgir me praakritik gufao tatha patthar ke banave dhanchon, dono ka upyog bhikshuon ke aavas ke liye hota tha. Aise sthal Chinese yaatriyon ke varnan tatha Bauddh granthon me bhi milte hain. Exam point: Pippal patthar-grih, jise Asuron ki gufa se joda jata hai, Bauddh parampara me Buddha ke nivash-sthal ke roop me jana jata hai.

qe: Jarasandha's seat or baithak above the Brahmakund at Rajgir is a platform built against the sloping side of the hill, of large rude blocks of which rock obtained from the adjacent hill?
qh: राजगीर में ब्रह्मकुंड के ऊपर जरासंध का बैठक पहाड़ी की ढलान पर लगे बड़े कच्चे पत्थरों के बने चबूतरे के रूप में है; इन पत्थरों को पास की पहाड़ी से निकाले गए किस पत्थर से बनाया गया था?
e: Rajgir me Brahmakund se kaafi upar pahadi par ek chabutra hai, jise Jarasandha ka Baithak ya seat kaha jata hai. Wahan tak koi raasta nahi banaya gaya tha; yah chabutra pahadi ki dhalan par bade kachche pattharon ko lagakar banaya gaya hai. Ye patthar aas-paas ki pahadi se nikaale gaye the aur unki pehchan ek laal rang ka jasper batayi gayi hai, jisme safed rang ki patli dhaar-dhaar banayi hui hoti hai. Pattharon me ek inch tak hawa ke asar se badlav dikhne se yah andaaza lagaya gaya ki unhe bahut purane samay me nikal kar lagaya gaya hoga. Is chabutre par ek Musalman sant ki bhi qabr bani thi, jo ab jald hi mit chuki hai. Exam point: Jarasandha ka Baithak pahadi ki dhalan par lage laal jasper ke bade kachche pattharon ka bana chabutra hai, jahan tak koi banaya hua raasta nahi jata tha.

qe: An inscription outside which cave at Rajgir records that Muni Vairadeva made two caves for ascetics desiring to attain Nirvana, and that these caves are renowned on account of the Arhats?
qh: राजगीर की किस गुफा के बाहर का अभिलेख बताता है कि मुनि वैरदेव ने निर्वाण चाहने वाले तपस्वियों के लिए दो गुफाएँ बनवाईं और ये गुफाएँ अर्हतों के कारण प्रसिद्ध हैं?
e: Sonbhandar gufa ke bahar ek abhilekh khuda hua hai, jisme likha hai ki Muni Vairadeva ne aise tapasviyon ke liye do gufayein banwayi jo nirvan prapt karna chahte the, aur ye gufayein Arhaton ke kaaran prakhyat hain. Arhat un mahapurushon ko kaha jata hai jinhone moh ko jeev kar sanchit karmon ka nash kar diya ho. Is abhilekh ki lipi tatha shabdavali teesri ya chauthee sadi Isvi ki batayi jati hai, aur isme aaye takniki shabd is baat ki or ishara karte hain ki yah sthal Jain parampara se juda tha, na ki Bauddh. Isi kaaran vidwanon ka matlab hai ki Sonbhandar gufa kisi Jain muni ne apne sampraday ke prayog ke liye banwayi thi. Exam point: Sonbhandar gufa ke bahari abhilekh ke mutabik Muni Vairadeva ne nirvan ke ichhuk tapasviyon ke liye do gufayein banwayi thi.

qe: The upper surface of Jarasandha's seat at Rajgir measures about how much, its perpendicular height at the highest corner being about twenty-eight feet?
qh: राजगीर में जरासंध के बैठक की ऊपरी सतह लगभग कितनी है, जबकि सबसे ऊँचे कोने पर उसकी लंबवत ऊँचाई लगभग अट्ठाईस फुट है?
e: Jarasandha ke Baithak ka chabutra pahadi ki dhalan par bane ek chabutre ke roop me hai, jiski upari satah ka napa lagbhag unyasi feet guna bahattar feet bayaya gaya. Sabse unche kone par uski lambvat unchai lagbhag atthais feet banti hai. Aaj bhi iske kundon ke paas tatha unse kaafi upar kai tapasvi chhote-chhote eenton ke chabutre banate hain, jin par baith kar woh un mahinon me dhyaan karte hain jab yatri yahan ikattha hote hain. Is tarah ek prachin chabutra aaj ki tirth-yatra ke saath bhi juda hua dikhta hai, aur yah dikhata hai ki Rajgir ke jharnon tatha pahadi ke chabutre sadiyon se dharmik jeevan ka kendra bane rahe hain. Exam point: Jarasandha ke Baithak ki upari satah lagbhag 79 feet guna 72 feet hai, aur sabse unche kone par uski unchai lagbhag 28 feet hai.

qe: Which archaeologist, in 1899, suggested the northern scarp of the Baibhar hill, about a hundred feet below the Jain temple of Adinatha, as the site of the Sattapanni cave?
qh: किस पुरातत्ववेत्ता ने 1899 में आदिनाथ जैन मंदिर से लगभग सौ फुट नीचे बैभार पहाड़ी की उत्तरी ढलान को सत्तपन्नी गुफा का स्थल बताया?
e: Sattapanni gufa, jahan pehli Bauddh sangiti hui thi, us sthal ko lekar vidwanon me matbhed raha hai. Ek mata ke mutabik ise Sonbhandar gufa se joda gaya, dusre mata me yah usi pahadi ke uttar ki taraf chattan ki dararon se bani prakritik gufa thi, aur teesre mata me ise Baibhar pahadi par Adinath Jain mandir se ek sau feet neeche uttari dhalan par rakha gaya; yah sujhav 1899 me Sir Aurel Stein ne diya. Unhone wahan ek lamba chabutra dekha, jiski deewar bade kache pattharon ki slats se bani thi, tatha uske aage patthar ki darar se bani ek gufa. Is tarah ek hi sthal ke liye kai sujhav dikhate hain ki puratattva me pehchan ka kaam kitna anuman-siddh hota hai. Exam point: 1899 me Sir Aurel Stein ne Baibhar pahadi ki uttari dhalan, Adinath mandir se lagbhag sau feet neeche, ko Sattapanni gufa ka sthal bataya.

qe: At the site proposed for the Sattapanni cave, the stratum of rock overhanging the caves is split vertically into how many sections, which may have given the cave its name?
qh: सत्तपन्नी गुफा के प्रस्तावित स्थल पर गुफाओं के ऊपर की चट्टान की परत खड़ी दिशा में कितने भागों में बँटी है, जिससे संभवतः इस गुफा का नाम पड़ा?
e: Sattapanni naam ko lekar ek sambhavna yah batayi jati hai ki jis sthal ko Sattapanni gufa ke liye chuna gaya, wahan gufao ke upar chattan ki parat khadi disha me saat hisson me bani hui hai. Sapta ka matlab saat aur parna yaani patta hota hai, isliye in saat hisson ko hi us gufa ke naam ka aadhar mana gaya. Is sujhav ko bal dene ke liye yah bhi dekha gaya ki pahadi ki dhalan par giri hui malba batati hai ki kabhi gufao ke samne ek chabutra ya platform raha hoga. Is tarah sthaniya naam, chattan ki banawat tatha malbe ke aadhar par puratattvavid ek sthal ki pehchan karte hain, chahe yah pehchan antim roop se siddh na ho. Exam point: Gufao ke upar ki chattan ki parat khadi disha me saat hisson me banti hai, aur shabd Sattapanni ka aadhar saptaparna yaani saat patte hai.

qe: Rajgir is a famous Jain tirtha; on which of its hills are there five Jain temples besides the ruins of an old Saiva shrine?
qh: राजगीर एक प्रसिद्ध जैन तीर्थ है; इसकी किस पहाड़ी पर पुराने शैव मंदिर के खंडहरों के अलावा पाँच जैन मंदिर हैं?
e: Aaj Rajgir Jain dharm ka ek bada tirth sthal hai, jahan Bharat ke alag-alag hisson se Jain yatri aate hain. In yatriyon ka mukhya aakarshan un paanch pahadiyon ki chotiyon par bane mandir hain. Baibhar pahadi par paanch Jain mandir hain, aur unke saath ek purane Shaiv mandir ke khandhar bhi milte hain. Ye mandir adhik tar aadhunik samay ke hain aur inme aam taur par ek patthar rakha hota hai, jis par kisi Jain Tirthankar ke charan-chinh bane hote hain. Rajgir me madhya-kaal ke purane mandir bhi mile hain, jinki kai Jain moortiyan ab pooja ke liye prayog nahi hotin. Is tarah ek hi sthal par purani aur nayi, tatha anek dharmik paramparaon ki upasana-dharaayein ek saath dikhti hain. Exam point: Baibhar pahadi par paanch Jain mandir tatha ek purane Shaiv mandir ke khandhar maujood hain.

qe: How many hot springs are there at the foot of the Baibhar hill at Rajgir and how many at the foot of Vipulagiri?
qh: राजगीर में बैभार पहाड़ी के नीचे कितने गर्म जल-स्रोत हैं और विपुलगिरि के नीचे कितने?
e: Rajgir ki pavitrata ka mukhya aadhar wahan ke garam jharna hai, jinhe log daivi shakti ka pragat roop maan kar poojte hain. Ye jharne Saraswati naam ki chhoti dhar ke dono kinaron par hain; Baibhar pahadi ke niche saat aur Vipulagiri ke niche chhe jharne hain. Baibhar ke saat jharnon ke naam Gunga Jamuna, Anant Rikhi, Sapta Rikhi, Byas Kund, Markanud Kund, Brahma Kund tatha Langat Kund hain, aur Vipulagiri ke chhah jharne Sita Kund, Suraj Kund, Ganesh Kund, Chandrama Kund, Ram Kund tatha Sringi Rikhi Kund kehlate hain. In kundon ke charon taraf pavitra imaratein banayi gayi hain, aur kuchh dinon me aath se das hazaar tak log snan ke liye ikattha hote hain. Exam point: Baibhar pahadi ke niche saat aur Vipulagiri ke niche chhe garam jharne hain, jo Saraswati dhar ke dono kinaron par hain.

qe: Which hot spring at Rajgir, about a quarter of a mile east of the others, was appropriated by the Muslims and is called Makhdum Kund after a saint who fasted there in a stone cell for forty days?
qh: राजगीर का कौन-सा गर्म जल-स्रोत, जो अन्य जल-स्रोतों से लगभग एक चौथाई मील पूर्व है, मुसलमानों ने अपने उपयोग में ले लिया और उसे उस संत के नाम पर मखदूम कुंड कहा जाता है जिसने वहाँ पत्थर की कोठरी में चालीस दिन उपवास किया?
e: Vipulagiri ke niche ke chhe jharnon me Sringi Rikhi Kund baaki jharnon se lagbhag ek chauthai mile purb me hai. Yahi jharana baad me Musalmanon ke adhikar me aa gaya aur unke dwara Makhdum Kund kaha jaane laga. Yah naam Makhdum Shah Sheikh Sharif-ud-din Ahmad ke naam par pada, jo Rajgir me rahte the aur is sthal par ek patthar ki kothri me chaalis din upvas karke tapasya ki thi. Aise sthal dikhate hain ki ek hi praakritik jharana alag-alag dharmik paramparaon ke liye pavitra ban jata hai, aur samay ke saath uske naam tatha prabandh bhi badalte hain. Rajgir ke jharnon ke aas-paas Jain, Bauddh, Shaiv tatha Sufi paramparaon ke chinh ek saath milte hain. Exam point: Sringi Rikhi Kund ko Musalmanon ne Makhdum Kund naam diya, jo ek patthar ki kothri me chaalis din upvas karne wale sant se juda hai.

qe: An analysis of the water of the Rajgir hot springs showed not more than how many parts of total solids in one hundred thousand?
qh: राजगीर के गर्म जल-स्रोतों के जल के विश्लेषण में एक लाख भागों में कुल ठोस पदार्थों की मात्रा कितने भाग से अधिक नहीं पाई गई?
e: Rajgir ke jharnon ka paani apni vishesh shuddhata ke liye bhi jana jata hai. Is paani ke ek vishleshan me yah paya gaya ki ek lakh hisson me ghule hue kul thos padarth sirf 6.8 hisse hain, yaani paani me ghulansh bahut kam hai. Thos padarth ka matlab hai paani me ghule hue khanij ya mineral, jaise calcium, sodium tatha anya lavan; kam ghulansh se paani halka, swachchh aur peene yogya rahta hai. Isi kaaran Rajgir ke jharne rogiyon ke liye bhi labhdayak mane jate hain, aur inme snan ko swasthya ke liye achha bataya jata hai. Iske viparit, paani me ghulansh adhik hone se woh kadwa, bhari tatha jaldi ganda hone wala ho jata hai. Exam point: Rajgir ke jharnon ke paani me ek lakh hisson me kul thos padarth sirf 6.8 hisse paye gaye, jo uski uchch shuddhata dikhate hain.

qe: The hot springs of Rajgir are usually hottest in which months, when the outflow is at its maximum?
qh: राजगीर के गर्म जल-स्रोत सामान्यतः किन महीनों में सबसे अधिक गर्म रहते हैं, जब उनका बहाव चरम पर होता है?
e: Rajgir ke garam jharne saal bhar ek jaisi garami nahi rakhte; unka tapan tatha paani ka bahav mausam ke saath badalta rahta hai. Inka tapan aam taur par November tatha December mahine me sabse zyada hota hai, aur isi samay unka bahav bhi apne charam par rahta hai. Iske viparit, sookhe mausam me kai jharne sookh jate hain ya unka bahav kam ho jata hai. Garam jharnon ka tapan zameen ke andar gehere dararon se aane wale paani par nirbhar karta hai, isliye mausam aur bhugarbhiya paani ke star me badlav se bahav tatha tapan dono prabhavit hote hain. Yahi kaaran hai ki chikitsa aur snan ke liye log sardiyon ke mahine me yahan zyada aate hain. Exam point: Rajgir ke garam jharne November tatha December me sabse adhik garam hote hain, aur tabhi unka bahav charam par rahta hai.

qe: The lowest level of the excavations at New Rajgir, about eight feet below the surface, yielded two clay seals inscribed in which script of the first or second century B.C.?
qh: नए राजगीर की खुदाई के सबसे निचले स्तर से, जो सतह से लगभग आठ फुट नीचे था, पहली या दूसरी शताब्दी ईसा पूर्व की किस लिपि में खुदे दो मिट्टी के मुहर मिले?
e: Naye Rajgir me 1906 se 1909 ke beech khudai karayi gayi, jisme dharm-nirpeksh yaani sada grihon ke avshesh mile: kuchh eenton ke aur kuchh patthar ki patli chadaron ke bane hue. Ye avshesh teen staron me the, aur sabse nichla star zameen ki satah se lagbhag aath feet neeche tha. Isi nichle star me do mitti ki muharein mili, jin par khudi hui lipi pehli ya doosri sadi Isvi poorv ki Brahmi thi, jise padha nahi ja saka. Brahmi Bharat ki sabse purani jani jane wali lipi hai, jisse baad me Devanagari tatha anya lipiyan bani. Isse pata chalta hai ki Rajgir me Maurya tatha Shunga kaal me bhi basti ghana thi aur likhne-padhne ka vyavahar tha. Exam point: Naye Rajgir ki khudai ke sabse nichle star se pehli-dusri sadi Isvi poorv ki Brahmi lipi me khudi do mitti ki muharein mili, jo padhi nahi ja sakin.

qe: The pedestal of a large statue found in a plinth at New Rajgir carried an inscription in the characters of which period?
qh: नए राजगीर में एक दीवार के बेस से मिली बड़ी प्रतिमा के पीठिका पर किस काल की लिपि में अभिलेख था?
e: Naye Rajgir ki khudai me ek deewar ke base se ek bade sthan ki pithika mili, jis par khuda hua abhilekh pehli-doosri sadi Isvi ke Kushan kaal ki lipi me tha. Us moorti ke sirf pair hi bache the. Vidwanon ne yah bhi bataya ki yah moorti Mathura vidyalaya ki parece hai aur Sravasti tatha Sarnath me mili do milti-julti moortiyon se milti hai. Mathura vidyalaya apni laal rang ki patthar aur gol-motor aakritiyon ke liye jana jata hai, jo Kushan kaal me Uttar Bharat me phaila. Isse yah samajh me aata hai ki Kushan kaal me Rajgir ka sampark Uttar Bharat ke kala-kendron se tha aur yahan bhi moorti-pooja ka khub prachar tha. Exam point: Naye Rajgir me mili bade sthan ki pithika par Kushan kaal ki lipi me abhilekh tha, aur moorti ko Mathura vidyalaya ka bataya gaya.

qe: In the secular buildings excavated at New Rajgir between 1906 and 1909, the rooms were all small, the largest being not more than how much?
qh: 1906 से 1909 के बीच नए राजगीर में मिली गृह-इमारतों के कमरे छोटे थे, सबसे बड़ा कमरा कितने से अधिक बड़ा नहीं था?
e: Naye Rajgir ki khudai me aam grihon ke avshesh bhi mile, jo kuchh eenton ke tatha kuchh patthar ki patli chadaron ke bane hue the. In imaraton ke sabhi kamre chhote the, aur sabse bada kamra bhi aath feet chaukor se adhik bada nahi tha. Chhote kamre tatha patli chadaron wali deewaron se lagta hai ki yah sadharan logon ki basti thi, na ki kisi bade dhanik logon ke mahal. Aise avashesh puratattvavid ke liye is baat ka pramaan hote hain ki us samay ke aam jeevan-sttar, tatha aavas-nirman me prayukt samagri kaisi thi. Rajgir ki khudaiyon se mili muharein tatha pithika dikhati hain ki yah sirf dharmik sthal nahi, ek ghana basa nagar bhi tha. Exam point: Naye Rajgir ki khudai me sabse bada kamra bhi aath feet chaukor se adhik bada nahi tha, jo sadharan grih-nirman ki or ishara karta hai.

qe: The village of Silao in the Bihar subdivision, a large grain mart on the Rajgir extension of the light railway, is a contraction of the name of which famous monastery?
qh: बिहार अनुमंडल का गाँव सिलाव, जो लाइट रेलवे के राजगीर विस्तार पर एक बड़ा अनाज मंडी है, किस प्रसिद्ध विहार के नाम का संक्षेपण है?
e: Silao gaon Bihar subdivision me Bihar se das mile dakshin me, Bakhtiyarpur-Bihar light railway ke Rajgir tak ke bistar par sthit hai. Yah ek bada anaaj ka mandi hai aur yahan police-station hai; kaha jata hai ki jile ka sabse achha basmati chawal yahan milta hai. Rail aaone se pehle yahan ki bhuni hui chawal tatha mithaiyan zyadatar Rajgir jane wale yatriyon ko bechi jati thi. Is gaon ka naam Vikramasila ka sanskaran hai, jo Bharat ke sabse prasiddh Bauddh viharon me se ek tha. Tibbati granthon se pata chalta hai ki gyahavin sadi me yah vidya ka bada kendra tha, aur Muhammadan akraman me yah vihar jal kar nash ho gaya. Exam point: Silao ka naam Vikramasila vihar se bana hai, jo ek samay Bharat ke sabse prasiddh Bauddh vidya-kendron me se ek tha.

qe: The village of Telarha in the extreme south-west of the Bihar subdivision has been identified with which place, the first visited by Hiuen Tsiang in the seventh century on his journey south from Patna?
qh: बिहार अनुमंडल के अत्यंत दक्षिण-पश्चिम में स्थित तेलाढ़ा गाँव की पहचान किस स्थान से की गई है, जहाँ ह्वेनसांग ने सातवीं शताब्दी में पटना से दक्षिण की यात्रा में सबसे पहले पड़ाव डाला?
e: Telarha gaon Bihar subdivision ke ekdum dakshin-pashchim me, Masaurhi railway station se terah mile dakshin-purb me sthit hai. Yah Phalgu nadi ki do shakhon, Kattar tatha Sona, ke beech zameen ki ek sankri patti par basa hai. Is gaon ki pehchan Tailadhak se ki gayi hai, jahan Hiuen Tsiang ne saatvin sadi me Patna se dakshin ki or jate samay sabse pehla padaav dala tha. Us samay yahan ek bada Bauddh vihar tha, jiska varnan Hiuen Tsiang ne kiya. Aaj us vishal vihar ka sthal kai teelon ke roop me bacha hai, jisme ek teela Bulandi kehlata hai. Exam point: Telarha ki pehchan Tailadhak se ki jati hai, jo Patna se dakshin ki or Hiuen Tsiang ka pehla padaav tha.

qe: At Tetrawan two great sheets of water lie on the north and south of a mound with a ruined fort surrounded by a moat; what are these two tanks called?
qh: तेतरवाँ में खाई से घिरे टूटे किले वाले टीले के उत्तर और दक्षिण में पानी की दो बड़ी झीलें हैं; इन दोनों तालाबों को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Tetrawan gaon Bihar subdivision ke dakshin me, Giriak se das mile uttar-purb tatha Bihar se chhah mile dakshin-purb me sthit hai. Yah gaon purani Bauddh imaraton ke kai teelon se pehchana jata hai, aur yahan kai Bauddh moortiyan bhi mili hain. Gaon me paani ki do badi jhilein hain - uttar me Dighi Pokhar tatha dakshin me Balam Pokhar. In dono ke beech ek nichi teele par khai se ghira ek toota hua qila hai, jise dekhte hue lagta hai ki us samay paani tatha suraksha, dono ko dhyan me rakh kar sthal chuna gaya tha. Bauddh vihar aksar aise hi sthalon par bante the, jahan paani tatha bhoomi ki upjau shakti dono hi paryapt ho. Exam point: Tetrawan me uttar me Dighi Pokhar tatha dakshin me Balam Pokhar naam ke do bade talab hain, jinke beech khai wala toota qila hai.

qe: The ruined house near Rajgir called the fort of Senek Raja measured about what?
qh: राजगीर के पास 'सेनेक राजा का किला' कही जाने वाली टूटी हुई इमारत लगभग कितनी बड़ी थी?
e: Rajgir ke paas, maidan ke beech Kutinagiri ke pashchim sire par, ek purani jagah Hangsapur Nagar ke naam se jani jati hai. Yahan ek tooti hui imarat ke avshesh mile, jo lagbhag assi feet guna saath feet ke the; iski deewarein kachche patthar tatha mitti ki bani thi aur sirf char-paanch feet unchi bachi thi. Isi imarat ko Rajgir ke log Senek Raja ka qila kehte the, yaani us raja ka qila jise Jain parampara Srenik ke naam se janti hai. Iske paas ek chhota Jain mandir tatha ek abhilekh bhi mila, aur mandir ek aise kuen ke upar bana tha jiski deewar eenton se bani thi aur jo baad me bhar diya gaya. Exam point: Senek Raja ka qila kehla ne wala toota bhawan lagbhag 80 feet guna 60 feet ka tha, jiski deewarein mitti aur kachche patthar ki thi.

qe: How many monks devoted themselves to study at the great monastery of Tailadhaka, where the learned from distant countries flocked to its halls?
qh: तैलधक के महान विहार में कितने भिक्षु अध्ययन में लगे रहते थे, जिसके प्रांगणों में दूर-दूर देशों के विद्वान आते थे?
e: Telarha yaani Tailadhak ke vihar ka varnan karte hue bataya gaya ki yah ek shaandar imaraton ka samuh tha, jisme char aangan, kai darren tatha mandap, unche burj tatha pagoda the. Yahan ek hazaar bhikshu vidya-adhyayan me lage rahte the, aur door-door deshon se vidwan log iske pranganon me aate the. Bhikshu yaani Bauddh sanyasi, jo vihar me rah kar dharma tatha vidya ka adhyayan karte the. Itni badi vidya-sanrachna dikhati hai ki saatvin sadi me bhi Magadha kshetra Bauddh vidya ka bada kendra tha, aur yahan aane wale vidwan door deshon se bhi yahan aate the. Baad me Muhammadan kaal me in imaraton ka patthar nayi imaraton ke liye istemal ho gaya. Exam point: Tailadhak ke vihar me ek hazaar bhikshu adhyayan me lage rahte the aur door-door deshon ke vidwan uske pranganon me aate the.

qe: From the towers of the monastery at Tetrawan, besides the hills of Giriak and Bihar, which other hill was distinctly visible?
qh: तेतरवाँ के विहार के बुर्जों से गिरियक और बिहार की पहाड़ियों के अलावा कौन-सी अन्य पहाड़ी साफ दिखाई देती थी?
e: Tetrawan ke vihar ki sthiti itni achhi mani gayi ki kaha gaya ki yah ek sadharan mahatva ka vihar nahi tha, aur iski jagah Baragaon se bhi behtar thi. Iska kaaran yah tha ki aas-paas ka kshetra achhi tarah sinecha hua tatha upjau tha, aur charon or pedon ke jhund the. Vihar ke unche burjon se Giriak, Bihar tatha Parvati ki pahadiyan saaf dikhti thi. Balam talab ke kinare saal bhar hare-bhare rahte the, aur suryast ke samay is jheel ka drishya dekhne yogya tha; us samay hazaaron bhikshu is vihar me rahte the. Isi tarah viharaon ki sthiti ke chunav me paani, upjaoo zameen tatha drishya, teenon ka dhyan rakha jata tha. Exam point: Tetrawan ke vihar ke burjon se Giriak tatha Bihar ke saath-saath Parvati pahadi bhi saaf dikhti thi.

qe: A local story says that Raja Srinik gave new jewels daily to each of his how many wives, throwing the old ones into a well near Rajgir?
qh: स्थानीय कथा के अनुसार राजा श्रेणिक प्रतिदिन अपनी कितनी रानियों में से प्रत्येक को नए आभूषण देते थे और पुराने आभूषण राजगीर के पास एक कुएँ में फेंक देते थे?
e: Rajgir ke paas Senek Raja ke qile ke paas ek chhota Jain mandir hai, aur yah mandir ek aise kuen ke upar bana hua tha, jiski deewar eenton se bani thi aur jo aaj bhar diya gaya hai. Isi kuen se ek lok-katha judi hui hai. Katha ke mutabik raja Srinik ki tees raniyan thi, aur woh pratyek rani ko har din naye zevar dete the; purane zevar woh isi kuen me phenk dete the. Aage kaha jata hai ki kuen me jama hue yah bahumulya zevar baad me ek khushkismat badmaash ke haath lag gaye. Jain parampara me Srenik tatha Bauddh parampara me Bimbisara ek hi raja mane jate hain, isliye aise lok-aakhyaan Rajgir ke itihas ko dharmik kathao ke saath jodte hain. Exam point: Lok-katha ke mutabik raja Srinik ki tees raniyan thi, aur woh unke purane zevar ek kuen me phenkte the.

qe: The site of the great monastery at Telarha is marked by a number of mounds; one of them, literally covered with Muhammadan graves, is called what?
qh: तेलाढ़ा के महान विहार का स्थल कई टीलों से पहचाना जाता है; इनमें से एक टीला, जो मुसलमानों की कब्रों से लगभग ढका हुआ है, किस नाम से जाना जाता है?
e: Telarha ke vishal Bauddh vihar ka sthal aaj kai teelon ke roop me maujood hai, jo purani imaraton ke malbe se bane hain. Inme ek teela Bulandi yaani uncha teela kehlata hai, jo mitti ke dheron se bana hai aur uski satah par aaj bhi Muhammadan qabrein bani hui hain. Kisi sthal ke teele tatha unpar bani nayi qabrein batati hain ki purani imaratein toot kar zameen me mil gayin, aur unke malbe par nayi pidhi ke logon ne apne qabristan banaye. Isi sthal par ek bada patthar ki masjid bhi hai, jiska chabutra lagbhag poora purane Bauddh bhawanon ke khambon tatha pattharon se bana hai. Exam point: Telarha ke vihar ke sthal ke teelon me se ek Bulandi kehlata hai, jo Muhammadan qabron se lagbhag dhaka hua hai.

qe: The ruined bridge at Telarha, standing on the now nearly dried-up course of the Sona, was built with how many arches?
qh: तेलाढ़ा का टूटा हुआ पुल, जो अब लगभग सूख चुकी सोना नदी की धारा पर खड़ा है, कितने मेहराबों वाला बना था?
e: Telarha gaon Phalgu ki do shakhon, Kattar tatha Sona, ke beech ki sankri zameen par basa hai. Unneesvin sadi ke aarambh tak yah ek bada qasba tha, jiski aabaadi lagbhag das hazaar thi, lekin aaj yahan sirf bikhri hui ghar aur dukanein bach gayi hain, jinme lagbhag ek-tihai khali tatha toot rahi hain. Is kshetra me ek achha pul tha, jiske paanch mehrab abhi bhi khade hain, chahe niche Sona ki dhara lagbhag sookh chuki hai. Isi tarah ek bhavya masjid, jo poori tarah Bauddh samagri se bani hai, gaon ke purabi sire par toot rahi hai; yah sab dikhata hai ki Muhammadan kaal ke aakhir tak bhi Telarha apna purana mahatva kho nahi paaya tha. Exam point: Telarha ka purana pul paanch mehrabon wala tha, jo aaj bhi sookhi hui Sona dhara par khada hai.

qe: The village of Ongari is said to derive its name from one of the appellations of which deity, whose temple there is old but still in good repair?
qh: ओंगारी गाँव का नाम किस देवता के एक नाम से निकला बताया जाता है, जिसका वहाँ का मंदिर पुराना है पर अब भी अच्छी हालत में है?
e: Ongari me ek achha talab hai, jo lagbhag sau gaj chaukor hai tatha jismein jangli ghaas tatha khaar-patar nahi ugte. Bahut lambe samay tak yah sthal pooja-path ka kendra raha hai, aur kaha jata hai ki gaon ka naam surya ke ek naam se nikla hai. Yahan surya ka mandir purana hai, lekin ab bhi theek-thak halat me khada hai; iske aas-paas kisi bade bhawan ke chinh nahi milte, phir bhi is kshetra me kai purani moortiyan milti hain. Surya ke ek naam se gaon ka naam banna dikhata hai ki yah kshetra purane daur se hi ek teerth sthal tha tatha log yahan surya ki upasana karte the. Exam point: Ongari ka naam surya ke ek naam se nikla bataya jata hai; yahan surya ka purana mandir aaj bhi acchi halat me hai tatha gaon me lagbhag sau gaj chaukor ek talab hai.

qe: The very large figure of the three-headed Sakti standing south-west of the Jain temple at Baragang was called a female Amba by the Pandit, but was more probably a representation of which deity?
qh: बारागंग के जैन मंदिर के दक्षिण-पश्चिम में खड़ी तीन सिर वाली बहुत बड़ी शक्ति-प्रतिमा को पंडित ने स्त्री अंबा कहा, पर वह अधिक संभवतः किस देवी की प्रतिमा मानी गई?
e: Baragang me Jain mandir se thoda dakshin-pashchim ki or ek bahut badi teen-sir wali Sakti ki moorti khadi thi. Sakti ka arth hai Devi ya shakti ki upasana se judi moorti, tatha teen sir wali moorti kisi devi ke kai roopon ka sanket hoti hai. Pandit yaani dharmik granthon ka path karne wale vidwan ise ek stri Amba kehte the, lekin moorti ke chinh dekh kar anuman lagaya gaya ki yah sambhavtah Jaya Devi ki moorti hai. Moorti ki pehchan ke liye uske sir, hath tatha aayudh jaise chinh dekhe jate hain, aur ek hi moorti ko alag-alag log apni parampara ke hisab se alag naam de dete hain. Is tarah Rajgir kshetra me Bauddh, Jain tatha Devi-upasana, teenon paramparaon ke chinh ek saath milte hain. Exam point: Baragang me Jain mandir ke dakshin-pashchim me khadi badi teen-sir wali Sakti ko Pandit stri Amba kehte the, par uske roop ke aadhar par use Jaya Devi ki moorti mana gaya.

qe: At Ongari the door of the temple of the sun now faces the west, though it formerly faced the opposite direction; this change is explained by what local story?
qh: ओंगारी में सूर्य मंदिर का दरवाज़ा अब पश्चिम की ओर है, जबकि पहले वह उलटी दिशा में था; यह बदलाव किस स्थानीय कथा से समझाया जाता है?
oe: A flood once carried the temple away and set it down facing the other way
A Brahman priest turned the whole temple round by the power of his mantras
A king rebuilt the temple with its door towards the west
When the heretics came to destroy the temple, the door turned round of itself
oh: एक बाढ़ मंदिर को बहाकर दूसरी दिशा में रख गई
एक ब्राह्मण पुजारी ने मंत्र-शक्ति से पूरा मंदिर घुमा दिया
एक राजा ने मंदिर दरवाज़ा पश्चिम की ओर करके बनवाया
जब विधर्मी मंदिर तोड़ने आए, तब दरवाज़ा स्वयं घूम गया
e: Ongari ke surya mandir ka darwaza aaj pashchim ki or khulta hai, lekin pehle yah ulatee disha me tha. Is badlav ke peeche ek lok-katha hai. Kaha jata hai ki ek samay yahan ke vidharmi yaani doosre dharm ke log is mandir ko todne ke liye aaye; jab woh andar ghusne hi wale the, tab darwaza khud hi ghoom gaya. Yah aashcharyajanak ghatna dekh kar woh dar gaye tatha mandir todne ka irada chhod kar laut gaye. Isi tarah ki kathayein dikhati hain ki mandir ki suraksha tatha uski pavitrata ko bachane ke liye logon ne dharmik aakhyaan banaye, jisse sthal ki mahimaa aur bhi badh gayi. Aise aakhyaan mandir ki sthapna tatha uske kisi chhote se badlav ko bade chamatkar se jod dete hain. Exam point: Ongari ke surya mandir ka darwaza pehle ulatee disha me tha; katha ke mutabik jab vidharmi use todne aaye, tab darwaza khud ghoom gaya tatha woh dar kar laut gaye.

qe: Among the two images worshipped in the temple at Ongari, the one called Vishnu entirely resembled the images at Giriak known by which name?
qh: ओंगारी के मंदिर में पूजी जाने वाली दो प्रतिमाओं में से विष्णु कहलाने वाली प्रतिमा गिरियक की किस नाम से जानी जाने वाली प्रतिमाओं जैसी थी?
e: Ongari ke mandir me do moortiyon ki pooja hoti thi. Inme se ek ko Surjo kaha jata tha, jiski banawat thik usi tarah ki thi jaise Bodh Gaya kshetra me milne wali surya-moortiyan hoti hain. Doosri moorti ko Vishnu kaha jata tha, aur yah pooree tarah Giriak me milne wali un moortiyon jaisi thi, jinhe Vasudeva ke naam se jana jata tha. Vasudeva Krishna ka hi ek naam hai, isliye Vasudeva naam ki moortiyan Vaishnav parampara se judi hoti hain, jinme bhagwan ko khade ya baithay hue roop me dikhaya jata hai. Ek hi mandir me surya tatha Vishnu, dono ki moortiyan milna dikhata hai ki us daur me kshetra me kai dharmik paramparaon ka mel tha tatha ek sthal ki moortikala doosre sthalon se aadan-pradan karti thi. Exam point: Ongari ki Vishnu naam ki moorti Giriak ki un moortiyon jaisi thi, jinhe Vasudeva kaha jata tha; pooja ki doosri moorti Surjo thi, jo Bodh Gaya ki surya-moortiyon jaisi thi.
